950a91923f.tl_dr: IRAF 是插在全双工语音模型内部的逐帧音频可信度门，用目标声纹降低背景说话人对 LLM 上下文的污染。
950a91923f.problem: 端到端双通道模型通常把用户音频和助手侧表示直接融合。在多人或有背景语音时，非目标说话人的声音也会进入条件上下文，造成误接话、漏响应和答案跑偏。
950a91923f.method: IRAF 将目标说话人 embedding 与当前及历史用户音频 embedding 输入一个轻量因果 Transformer，预测范围为 0 到 2 的逐帧可靠性门。门值先缩放用户音频表示，再与助手表示融合，因此既能抑制干扰帧，也能保留或增强目标用户帧。
workflow: ECAPA-TDNN 提取目标说话人声纹。
流式语音编码器以约 80ms 粒度产生用户音频表示。
单层因果 Transformer 预测每帧可靠性门。
缩放后的音频表示进入 LLM，模型继续生成文本和语音。
findings: 在 InstructS2S-200K 的干扰说话人条件下，响应成功率由噪声增强基线的 69.2% 提升到 91.0%。
同一条件下响应延迟由 0.97 秒降至 0.82 秒，打断停止成功率达到 99.8%。
project_fit: 可借鉴为“声纹 + 座位/波束 + AEC 置信度”的多人音频门，再决定哪些音频允许写入流式 KV。
不应直接照搬单目标用户设计，否则可能误杀副驾和后排乘员的合法指令。
limitations: 实验干扰主要由 MUSAN 模拟，未覆盖真实车内混响、扬声器回声和麦克风阵列。
IRAF 位于模型 embedding 融合层，需要联合训练；不是可直接挂到现有 Harness 的独立服务。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-07-30，论文公开，但未找到官方实现代码或训练权重。

ff66a9b753.tl_dr: BayLing-Duplex 用一个约 9B 自回归 LLM 同时建模用户语音、助手文本和助手语音，让开口、沉默与打断都变成 next-token prediction。
ff66a9b753.problem: 传统语音助手依赖外部 VAD 和轮次控制器，难以自然处理重叠说话、犹豫与用户打断；多个控制模块也会增加时序复杂度。
ff66a9b753.method: 模型基于 GLM-4-Voice，将用户语音、助手文本和助手语音按块交错到一个多通道序列中，并加入 SILENCE、assistant、PAD、EPAD 等状态 token。模型通过 SFT 学习序列布局，再用 DPO 优化开口和打断时机。
workflow: 语音 tokenizer 将连续用户音频离散化。
单个 LLM 联合预测对话状态、助手文本和语音 token。
状态 token 决定继续沉默、开始回答或停止当前语音。
语音 decoder 将预测 token 还原为声音。
findings: 论文报告 InstructS2S-Eval 轮次切换成功率 92%，打断成功率 100%。
Llama Questions 准确率 46.0%，高于论文中 Moshi 的 21.0%。
project_fit: 适合作为原生全双工语音基线，并借鉴状态 token 与交互 DPO 的训练目标。
不宜直接替换 Qwen3-Omni：它没有视觉输入，也未证明适应车内噪声、多乘员和车控安全。
limitations: 模型卡明确表示主要在合成近场语音上评估，未覆盖多方对话、情绪轮替和复杂噪声。
基于 GLM-4-Voice 自定义许可，商业使用需要登记并遵守标注要求。

open_source.note: 推理代码和模型权重已公开，但不是 MIT/Apache 宽松许可。

8539ccbdae.tl_dr: DuplexSLA 在统一的 160ms 时间线上联合生成助手语音与独立 Action 流，使听、说、规划和工具调用可以并行。
8539ccbdae.problem: 现有全双工语音模型通常没有原生工具通道：工具调用要么等待轮次结束，要么由外部级联处理，造成动作延迟并割裂口播。
8539ccbdae.method: 它采用双音频流、三语义通道：连续用户音频、离散助手语音，以及限速的文本 Action 通道。Action 通道承载转写、规划、response/interrupt/backchannel 标签和结构化工具 JSON，每个动作都带明确的 160ms 时间位置。
workflow: 每个 160ms 块接收两份 80ms 用户音频特征。
同一主干预测一个文本锚点和四个 40ms 助手语音 token。
Action 通道每块最多输出 10 个文本 token，超出部分顺延。
工具调用与助手口播并行，interrupt 标签可让语音迅速切换为静音。
findings: 工具调用平均延迟为 0.64 秒，ASR+LLM 级联为 2.77 秒；对应准确率分别为 85.56% 和 91.33%。
论文报告正常接话、停顿、打断和附和识别准确率分别为 96.00%、93.33%、99.33% 和 98.33%。
project_fit: 最值得借鉴的是独立、带时间戳的 Action 事件流，可逐步替代混在口播文本中的 §车控标签§。
短期仍应保留本地确定性执行层；模型产生 Action 不等于动作可以无条件落车。
limitations: 该能力依赖约 32 万小时持续预训练和约 5 万小时后训练，不是 Harness 级的小改。
工具结果显示速度显著提升，但准确率略低于级联基线。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-07-30 仅技术报告和项目页公开；推理代码、权重与 DuplexSLA-Bench 标注为 coming soon。

dc8da916f7.tl_dr: Phoenix-VAD 是直接听音频的二分类语义端点检测器，用来判断用户语义是否完整，而不只是检测有没有声音。
dc8da916f7.problem: 能量 VAD 会把犹豫停顿当成话轮结束；ASR+文本端点模型虽然懂语义，却增加级联延迟并丢失声学信息。
dc8da916f7.method: 约 150M 的 Zipformer 提取音频特征，两层 Adapter 对齐到 Qwen2.5-0.5B。模型查看约 2.56 秒滑动窗口，每 320ms 输出 Continue Speaking 或 Stop Speaking，并给完整与未完整语句使用不同等待阈值。
workflow: 持续接收用户原始音频，不依赖额外 ASR。
滑动窗口保留局部上下文并进行流式前向。
语义未完整时继续等待，完整时采用较短超时提交话轮。
findings: 论文测试集中完整和未完整语音场景准确率约为 98.6% 和 98.5%。
A6000 上单次状态预测约 50ms。
project_fit: 可作为 RMS VAD 后的第二道语义闸，减少“然后把……”这类未说完就 commit。
它只判断继续或停止，不负责区分多人身份、附和与真正插话。
limitations: 训练语音大量由 TTS 合成；论文将真实录音和拒识能力列为未来工作。
每次推理仍需要语音编码器和 0.5B LLM，需评估座舱端侧资源。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-07-30 未找到官方完整代码和训练权重。

fd269fcd0f.tl_dr: SoulX-Duplug 是外挂在语音助手旁边的流式话轮状态预测器，负责判断用户正在说、没说完、已说完还是只在附和。
fd269fcd0f.problem: 传统半双工模型不知道何时接话；VAD→ASR→文本判断的级联既慢又割裂，重训整个全双工主干又成本太高。
fd269fcd0f.method: 它以 160ms 为一块，将音频 token、流式 ASR token 和五种状态 token 交错建模，输出 idle、nonidle、backchannel、complete、incomplete。训练统一优化 ASR 和状态预测，推理时由轻量 SenseVoice 提供 teacher-forced 流式文本。
workflow: GLM-4-Voice tokenizer 将音频变成 12.5Hz 离散 token。
每个 160ms 块生成局部 ASR 文本和当前用户状态。
complete 触发助手接话，incomplete 继续等待，backchannel 不抢走话权。
findings: 论文给出的理论平均状态判断延迟约 240ms。
项目同时开放中英文状态评测与完整对话系统示例。
project_fit: 是 StreamingModelHarness 最直接的候选：映射 complete→commit、incomplete→继续收音、backchannel→不取消播报。
初期应与现有 RMS VAD 双闸运行，先在真实车内回声、音乐和多人语音上 A/B。
limitations: 会占用额外推理资源，并与现有 faster-whisper 形成重复 ASR 链路。
开放模型在通用中英文场景训练，仍需验证车控短句、座位和远场音频。

open_source.note: 代码、模型、WebSocket 示例和 SoulX-Duplug-Eval 已公开。

fbbb375b6a.tl_dr: EchoChain 是检查语音助手被中途打断后能否更新任务状态、又不丢失原目标的受控评测。
fbbb375b6a.problem: 普通语音评测只看最终答案或打断速度，无法发现助手听见改口却继续旧计划、短暂更新后又忘记等状态推理错误。
fbbb375b6a.method: 基准用场景驱动对话，在相对助手开口的固定时刻注入与上下文相关的打断，再检查后续回答是否同时保留原任务和新增约束。
workflow: 建立含明确任务状态和约束的对话场景。
助手播报期间按统一时间注入用户改口。
比较打断前后状态，分类上下文惯性、打断遗忘和目标丢失。
findings: 论文评测的实时语音模型没有一个通过率超过 50%。
改为半双工对照后，总失败相对下降 40.2%，说明大量错误确由中途状态更新造成。
project_fit: 可直接改造成车控回归：机场改火车站、空调改车窗、执行中撤销和后续指代。
测试必须记录计划、下发、执行、撤销和补偿，而不仅是口播文本。
limitations: 它是诊断基准，不会自动修复 Harness。
截至 2026-07-30 未找到完整官方代码仓库，需要按论文协议自行实现车控版本。

open_source.note: 论文与方法公开，未找到完整官方 benchmark 代码。

a298114cb1.tl_dr: TurnNat 给双声道对话的轮替节奏打自然度分，关注谁在什么时候开口和停下，而不是回答内容。
a298114cb1.problem: 首响、抢话、重叠、沉默和附和等时序错误类型不同，单一延迟指标或人工听测很难统一比较。
a298114cb1.method: 一个在自然人类对话上训练的因果模型预测未来双人语音活动状态。实际对话越不像自然时序，其未来状态负对数似然越高；框架再聚合话轮边界附近的平均和尾部异常。
workflow: 准备用户与助手分离的双声道录音。
提取双方逐帧语音活动和话轮边界。
计算边界单元的 MeanNLL、TailNLL 和整段 DialogNLL。
用 NatScore 或自然/扰动样本差值比较版本。
findings: 论文构建了五类局部时序扰动，并经人工自然度判断验证。
TurnNat 能用同一似然信号识别延迟接话、过早开口、话权转移错误和过度附和。
project_fit: 给每次座舱回归录制用户/助手双轨，在标签正确率之外增加轮替自然度。
与 EchoChain 组合：EchoChain 测打断后状态对不对，TurnNat 测打断与恢复的节奏自然不自然。
limitations: 评分模型学习的是训练语料中的人类节奏，车内任务型对话可能需要重新校准。
它不判断车控语义、工具参数和动作安全。

open_source.note: 扰动生成、训练、评分代码与检查点使用说明已公开。

6c53ea8835.tl_dr: DyaPlex 在冻结的 PersonaPlex 全双工语音主干旁增加因果 Motion Tower，让智能体边听边说的同时感知对方动作并实时生成自己的身体动作。
6c53ea8835.problem: 已有全双工语音模型只处理声音；多数语音驱动动作模型又是离线生成，或看不到对方的身体动作，因此无法形成“我看见你的动作并立刻用动作回应”的闭环双人互动。
6c53ea8835.method: 它采用双塔结构：冻结的 PersonaPlex Speech Tower 保留语音对话能力，训练一个 32 层因果 Motion Tower 生成动作。双方动作经 RVQ-VAE 压成 12.5Hz token，并以 A/B 说话人标签交错成统一自回归序列；Motion Tower 在每层通过 cross-attention 读取对应层语音隐藏状态，时间对齐的 speech-motion RoPE 让动作优先关注同一时刻的语音特征。
workflow: PersonaPlex 持续接收双方语音并生成智能体语音，同时暴露 32 层流式隐藏状态。
因果 RVQ-VAE 将双方 25fps 的 SMPL-X 动作压缩为与语音一致的 12.5Hz token。
Motion Tower 在统一序列里读取对方动作 token，并只生成智能体位置的动作 token。
时间对齐 RoPE 和因果 mask 保证动作只能利用当前及历史语音，最终解码回 25fps 身体动作。
findings: 模型使用约 4000 小时 Seamless Interaction 数据；过滤后训练集约 3435 小时，测试集约 18 小时。
完整模型的 FGD 为 5.6×10⁻³、P-FD 为 7.3×10⁻³；移除对方动作输入后分别退化到 39×10⁻³ 和 41×10⁻³。
用户研究中，相比 Audio2Photoreal 和 DualTalk，参与者选择 DyaPlex 的比例分别为 66.3% 和 97.5%。
将动作上下文缩到 1024 token 后，Motion Tower 每帧约 80ms，在 12.5Hz 下达到实时推理。
project_fit: 最有价值的不是直接把身体动作搬进座舱，而是“冻结已有全双工主干，外挂一个与主干逐层对齐的流式模态塔”：未来可参考它增加乘员视觉、姿态或独立 Action 通道。
双方 token 交错与统一时间轴适合多人座舱研究，可用于表达乘员 A 的点头、手势与助手 B 的语音/界面反馈之间的时序关系。
它不能直接解决当前 Qwen3-Omni Harness 的 VAD、AEC、工具晚注入和车控安全问题，优先级应低于语义判停与回声治理。
limitations: 当前只支持两人互动；论文将多人 polyadic interaction 列为未来工作。
动作塔逐个解码每帧 22 个 code，完整 4096-token 上下文时需要 173ms/帧，必须缩短动作上下文才能实时。
模型输出通用 SMPL-X 骨架动作，不包含真实人的身份外观；若接下游视频生成仍存在深度伪造风险。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-07-31，论文和 NVIDIA Research 项目演示页公开，未找到官方代码或模型权重发布。

b58c7fb4b6.tl_dr: DuplexPO 只在接话、附和和打断附近的小窗口用强化学习优化“何时说”，再以 KL 约束保留 SFT 模型“说什么”的能力。
b58c7fb4b6.problem: 自然对话 SFT 把内容与时序一起模仿，既可能带入不合适的闲聊风格，也可能削弱推理；整段对话奖励又很难归因到具体开口、停声和附和时刻。
b58c7fb4b6.method: 模型以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 为语言骨干，配流式 Parakeet 编码器、语音 codec 和流匹配生成器。训练从 Fisher 与 Seamless 对话截取 dynamics-critical windows，用 FCDR 分别奖励起始时机、附和、打断后让权和参与模式；每窗采样四条轨迹，以 GRPO 式组内优势和 KL 项更新。
workflow: 从双声道对话中定位轮次转换、附和和 barge-in 事件。
围绕事件构造带前置上下文与后置缓冲的小窗口。
固定窗口外历史，在窗口内采样多条实时动作轨迹。
用 FCDR 分项评价开始、附和、停止和参与模式，再执行 GRPO 更新。
findings: Table 2 中 Fisher onset MAE 为 0.69 秒，完整轮次 initiation/yield 为 100.0%/98.7%；SFT 基线为 0.98 秒和 97.8%/92.1%。
Table 3 中 FDB-v3 的 turn-take 为 100.0%、延迟 0.24 秒、VIR 5.0%、yield 100.0%；Moshi 延迟 0.44 秒、VIR 12.0%、yield 71.9%。
Table 4 中 SFT→DuplexPO 的 LlamaQ 为 72.0→75.3，AlpacaEval 为 3.43→3.68，OpenBookQA 为 72.2→73.7。
Gemini 3.0 Pro 配对评审中，Fisher 总体胜率为 76.9%（20/26，p=0.009）。
project_fit: 编辑判断：可借用 FCDR 的分项奖励训练或评测 Harness 的判停、附和、让权和 TTS 停声控制器。
编辑判断：DuplexPO 优化原生持续监听与发声策略，不能把其 0.24 秒延迟或模型级全双工结论外推到判停后才生成、晚注入工具且外挂 TTS 的 Harness。
limitations: FCDR 未覆盖用户意图、内容、说话风格和文化相关时序偏好，人工时序也不是唯一真值。
局部窗口训练可能忽略跨多轮连贯性；体验改善主要由 Gemini 配对评审支持，并非真实用户研究。
Fisher 受 LDC 许可约束，论文专属训练窗口、实现和权重未发布。

open_source.note: 官方项目页 https://liyuxin44.github.io/DuplexPO/ 提供方法与音频演示；未找到 DuplexPO 代码或 checkpoint。Seamless Interaction 数据公开为 CC BY-NC 4.0，Fisher 需 LDC 许可。

653ff20c8a.tl_dr: 该工作用 GRPO 分别优化原生双音频流模型的停顿、接话、附和和用户打断，并叠加语义奖励，避免只追求低延迟而损伤回答内容。
653ff20c8a.problem: 逐 token 的监督学习不直接优化何时说、何时沉默和何时让权；现有强化学习又常只处理单一行为，出现时序变快但语义质量下降。
653ff20c8a.method: 论文从 Fisher 和 Seamless 双声道语料按 pause、turn、backchannel、interruption 四类事件抽取短片段。每片段由 Moshi 或 PersonaPlex 采样 16 个完成，分别计算沉默违规、负响应延迟、附和位置 F1 和打断延迟；接话与打断再加入 Qwen3-235B-A22B 语义奖励，以 clipped GRPO 和 KL 约束更新并行文本控制流。
workflow: 对双声道人类对话执行 VAD，并按四类交互规则抽取片段。
随机附加最多 30 秒前置上下文，为每片段采样 16 个完成。
计算轴特定时序奖励，接话与打断再加入语义自然度奖励。
组内归一化优势，只更新文本控制 token，并以冻结参考模型做 KL 约束。
findings: Table 1 中 Moshi 经 Seamless RL 后，Synthetic Pause TOR 从 0.445 降至 0.307，用户打断延迟从 1.377 秒降至 0.409 秒。
Table 1 中 PersonaPlex 经 Seamless RL 后，Backchannel TOR 从 0.182 降至 0.073，平滑接话延迟从 0.219 秒降至 0.086 秒。
Table 2 中 PersonaPlex+RL 的 Correction Turn/Instruct/Task 从 3.803/2.945/3.080 提升至 4.501/3.369/3.620。
Table 3 中移除 LLM 奖励后，打断语义分从 3.58 降至 3.05，说明纯时序奖励不足以保住内容质量。
project_fit: 编辑判断：四轴事件定义和“时序+语义”组合奖励可直接用于 Harness 的 endpoint、打断取消、首音频和 TTS 停声回归。
编辑判断：论文模型在统一时间轴同时处理用户与助手音频；当前 Harness 是流式输入、判停后生成、晚注入工具和外挂 TTS，不能称为原生全双工。
limitations: 奖励依赖人工规则，且训练目标要求模型具有并行文本控制流。
没有真人交互评价；动态评测还因 GPT-Realtime 的 VAD 行为限制被测模型音频，不能视为完全无约束双工。
训练语料会改变安全行为；正文与附录对 LLM 奖励量表还存在 1–3 与 0–2 的不一致。

open_source.note: Moshika 与 PersonaPlex 的 Seamless RL 权重已公开，另有 https://huggingface.co/kyutai/personaplex-rl-seamless；权重为 CC BY-NC 4.0，未找到本文 GRPO 数据抽取和训练代码，Fisher 版本也未发布。

d36cd9bda6.tl_dr: SCoT 把单通道 SpeechLM 切成固定时长块，在每块语音前预测局部 ASR 或文本响应，以结构化中间监督改善语义；它是块级时分复用，不是双音频流逐帧并行。
d36cd9bda6.problem: VAD 难区分句中停顿和话轮结束，双通道架构训练复杂；简单块级时分复用虽然允许重叠，却常产生语义不连贯的回答。
d36cd9bda6.method: 系统用 CTC 强制对齐把完整转写和系统响应切成块级目标，比较 SCoT-ASR、SCoT-Response 与先转写再响应的 SCoT-Full。骨干是 SmolLM2-1.7B 初始化的 ESPnet SpeechLM，每帧联合 ESPnet-Codec 与 XEUS 聚类 token，默认以 2 秒块交替处理用户输入和生成助手输出。
workflow: 将双人电话对话切成固定 2 秒输入/输出块。
用 CTC 强制对齐生成每块的转写与响应文本目标。
按 ASR、Response 或 Full 路径预测块级中间 token。
条件于当前和历史块生成不超过块长的语音，再聚合为完整对话。
findings: Table 1 中 SCoT-Response 相对普通 Duplex E2E 的 ROUGE-1/2/L 从 14.4/1.4/10.3 提升至 27.9/6.8/19.8，perplexity 从 313.8 降至 42.3。
Table 2 中 SCoT-Response 的重叠块占比为 63.0%、precision/recall 为 59.5/66.8；SCoT-Full recall 为 71.5。
Tables 3–4 中 SCoT-Response 的 Emotion Rank 为 2.32、UTMOS 为 2.46，优于普通 Duplex E2E 的 5.60 和 1.95。
Table 5 中块长由 2 秒缩至 1 秒，RTF 从 0.85 降至 0.30，但 ROUGE-L 从 15.8 降至 7.1。
project_fit: 编辑判断：可借鉴“流式块输入→局部转写/计划→累积上下文”，在 endpoint 前做 partial prefill 或可撤销规划。
编辑判断：Harness 仍在判停后才生成并晚注入工具、交给外挂 TTS；不能把局部预处理描述成论文的端到端 SCoT 或模型级全双工。
limitations: 只在英语电话对话上用自动指标评测，没有真人实时多轮研究，且推理使用 ground-truth 历史块。
固定块长存在延迟与语义冲突，推理还从 10 个语音候选中重排，削弱实时工程说服力。
Table 5 正文对 2 秒 ROUGE-L 的描述与表格数值不一致。

open_source.note: ESPnet SpeechLM 基础代码公开为 Apache-2.0，但未找到 SCoT 专属实现、训练 recipe 或 checkpoint；Switchboard/Fisher 受 LDC 协议限制。

da29dadcff.tl_dr: CT-Duplex 在原生全双工模型的监听静音区生成可抢占的 Entity、Intent、Action、Knowledge、Logic 节点，用“用户说话时先想”改善推理型对话。
da29dadcff.problem: 全双工 SDLM 在用户说话时反复预测静音 token，既浪费监听窗口又可能强化重复退化；传统 CoT 要等完整输入后执行，过长且无法随未知 endpoint 抢占。
da29dadcff.method: 约 1.7B 的 CT-Duplex 由 12.5Hz 流式语音编码器、Qwen2.5-1.5B 初始化的 LLM 和自回归语音解码器组成。离线教师生成五类思考节点，训练时将完整节点尽量靠后填入助手静音区，空间不足则按节点截断，不挤占正式回答；用户停下后模型从思考切到文本与语音回答。
workflow: 生成对话文本，并由教师产生五类结构化思考节点。
用多说话人 TTS 合成双通道语音，并随机加入 barge-in。
按语音时间轴把完整思考节点写入助手静音区。
联合训练语音编码、文本 LLM 和语音解码，推理时持续思考并可被用户插话抢占。
findings: Table 3 中 SpokenWOZ 的 GPT 分数从 2.40 升至 2.61，BLEU 从 12.92 升至 16.30，Sentence-BERT 从 0.52 升至 0.59。
Table 4 中事实问答提升很小：Llama Questions 30.4%→31.4%，Web Questions 13.2%→13.3%。
Table 5 中无思考/有思考的轮次启动延迟为 0.45/0.68 秒，barge-in 成功率为 88.63%/94.05%。
Appendix Table 6 中思考链能完整容纳于用户时长的比例为 GenConv 98.91%、SpokenWOZ-G 96.78%、Llamaq-G 94.69%。
project_fit: 编辑判断：可在 Harness 的流式输入阶段维护可撤销的实体、意图和动作草稿，endpoint 后再与晚注入工具一起交给生成模型。
编辑判断：论文把思考和语音解码训练在统一时间轴；当前 Harness 判停后生成并用外挂 TTS，不能据此声称原生监听时思考或模型级全双工。
limitations: 评测主要依赖 Whisper 转写和 GPT-4o-mini，未报告多随机种子、置信区间或充分的真人研究。
训练大量依赖合成对话、合成语音和固定时序增强，且未公开思考标签生成提示或未来信息泄漏审计。
论文称无额外延迟，但 Table 5 中有思考版轮次启动延迟高 0.23 秒，正文叙述与表格还存在冲突。

open_source.note: 只找到 Apache-2.0 的通用 NeMo speechlm2 代码；CT-Duplex 专用实现、配置、联合微调权重、三套训练数据和许可证均未发布。

32efe0aaeb.tl_dr: 论文让 Gemini 直接读取完整双声道 WAV，对全双工代理做八维离线评分；部分维度可作为第四评分者，但天花板效应、低人类一致性和 DSP 盲点要求人工或程序兜底。
32efe0aaeb.problem: 现有音频裁判研究多评孤立 TTS 句子，缺少对完整双声道、重叠和插话会话的多人类验证，也常把排序相关、绝对校准与缺陷敏感度混为一谈。
32efe0aaeb.method: 数据含 152 个自然客服会话和 57 个成功渲染的对抗缺陷片段。三名校准评分者按八个 1–5 维度给出 5,016 条评分；Gemini 直接读取代理左声道、用户右声道的原始 WAV。分析同时计算 Spearman 相关、与三人均值相差不超过 1 分的比例、ordinal Krippendorff α 和缺陷检测 recall。
workflow: 抽取生产双声道会话，并构造六类 DSP 缺陷。
三名盲评者独立评分，Gemini 读取同一完整 WAV 返回八维结构化分数。
分别评估排序、绝对校准、机会校正一致性和缺陷敏感度。
保持提示不变替换 Gemini 型号，检查跨模型校准漂移。
findings: Table 1 中与三人均值相差不超过 1 分的比例从口音 92.3%、音频清晰度 89.0%，到语速适配 48.8%、整体保真度 43.5%，维度差异很大。
Table 1 中 audio_clarity 的人类间/LALM-人类 Spearman ρ 为 0.47/0.25，overall_fidelity 为 0.11/−0.01。
配对 McNemar 复核后，48 个缺陷×维度单元仅 2 个显著：clipping×audio_clarity 与 SNR noise×entity_pronunciation，均为人类 8/8、LALM 0/8。
Table 3 中 Gemini 2.5 Flash、3.5 Flash、3.1 Pro 的排序 headline 分别为 5/8、4/8、5/8，绝对一致 headline 为 6/8、8/8、5/8。
project_fit: 编辑判断：应保存用户/助手分声道录音，把音频模型当第四评分者，并用人工校准、绝对一致和受控缺陷共同验证。
编辑判断：该离线裁判不验证 Harness 的流式输入、endpoint、晚注入工具或外挂 TTS 架构；还需另测首音频、TTS 截断、工具结果回注和打断后取消。
limitations: 证据来自单一客服代理和三名评分者，缺陷单元仅 7–8 个且未做多重比较校正。
自然会话集中于高分区，高绝对一致不代表有强区分力；temperature=1 下也未测同一音频重复评分稳定性。
生产代理、完整 judge prompt 和 209 个原始 WAV 未公开，当前仓库无法端到端复现论文分数。

open_source.note: 官方仓库公开统计脚本和匿名评分 CSV：脚本 Apache-2.0，CSV/图 CC BY 4.0；完整提示、生产 judge、原始 WAV 与 Gemini 权重未公开，README 的额外用途限制还需发布方澄清。

7369317a9f.tl_dr: TurnGuide 按自然停顿动态切分助手话轮，并在每个语音块前生成短文本块，以改善端到端双工语音模型的语义连贯性；公开推理仍是整段 WAV 离线处理。
7369317a9f.problem: 全双工模型既要保持双声道时间对齐，又要避免纯语音 token 长序列的语义退化；文本指导插得过早缺上下文，过晚则语音先行，长度也会影响发言边界。
7369317a9f.method: 系统用 VAD、Whisper 逐词时间戳和 0.6 秒容差建立 turn 级文本—语音对齐。以 GLM-4-Voice 为骨干，把两路语音按 5 个 token、约 400ms 分块交错；助手文本也按 5 token 分块并加 EOC，再按首词时间戳放到对应助手语音块之前，比较 1:1、2:1、3:1 文本/语音损失权重。
workflow: 双通道录音经 VAD 合并为 IPU，并获取逐词转写和时间戳。
把用户与助手语音离散化并按约 400ms 块交错排列。
将助手 turn 文本切块，在对应语音块之前插入。
微调 GLM-4-Voice，按用户输入块生成文本与助手语音 token。
findings: Table 2 的语义总分中，SCI、Moshi TS 为 5.91、5.58，TurnGuide 1:1、2:1、3:1 分别为 7.27、7.70、7.79。
Table 5 中标准文本插入的 Conditional-All 为 6.76；提前 4 秒和延后 4 秒分别降至 5.61、5.94。
Tables 7–8 中 GPT 与人工成对判断匹配 25/30；TurnGuide 的 M-MOS/N-MOS 为 3.26/3.23，高于 Moshi 的 2.69/2.75。
论文只给出 0.69 秒理论首块延迟，未提供真实端到端流式延迟。
project_fit: 编辑判断：可借鉴 turn 级短文本规划，但应在 Harness endpoint 后、晚注入工具完成后确定最终文本，再交给外挂 TTS。
编辑判断：官方脚本先读取完整 WAV 再统一解码，不得把 checkpoint 或 0.69 秒理论值写成当前 Harness 的在线全双工能力。
limitations: 主要只在 Fisher 英语电话对话上验证，主语义评测依赖 GPT-4o，人工实验样本很小。
模型每个训练配置只跑一次，没有随机种子方差；Speech-QA 还只使用半双工模式。
未做 RLHF 或安全对齐，附录明确不建议直接用于生产。

open_source.note: 公开离线推理代码、演示和 2:1/3:1 两个 checkpoint，但未公开训练、对齐预处理和完整评测流水线。权重无独立许可证并受 GLM-4-Voice 自定义许可约束；Fisher 音频受 LDC 协议限制。

602fa5c48a.tl_dr: DuplexChat-Pipe 从播客抓取、筛选并分离双人语音，构建约 41.5 万小时英日双通道对话；公开的 792MB 资源是 URL/时间戳清单，不是可直接下载的音频。
602fa5c48a.problem: 全双工模型训练需要每位说话人独立、同步的音轨来保留 overlap、backchannel 和快速换轮，但现有大规模公开语音多是多人混合单声道。
602fa5c48a.method: 管线从 PodcastIndex/RSS 收集节目，过滤音乐与超长音频后转为 16kHz。pyannote diarization 在长静音处分段，只保留恰好两名活跃说话人的区间，并按时长和说话占比过滤；DialogueSidon 再联合执行说话人分离、降噪和去混响，输出左右声道。
workflow: PodcastIndex/RSS 经语言、音乐和重复 feed 过滤后下载节目。
执行 diarization，只保留满足时长与说话占比规则的双人区间。
DialogueSidon 分离、降噪和去混响，输出双声道 WebDataset。
发布 URL、时间区间和说话人清单，由使用者从源站本地重建音频。
findings: Tables I–II 中英语含 15,304,412 段、282,634 小时，日语含 7,329,011 段、132,723 小时，总计约 415k 小时。
Table III 中英语/日语 DNSMOS 为 2.92/3.11、SQ-STOI 为 0.96/0.98；日语 ITC 为 0.320，低于英语和 Fisher 的 0.383。
Table IV 中日语 turn exchange 为 10.5 次/分钟、平均 turn 4.0 秒，英语为 6.2 次/分钟、7.9 秒；同时发言占比为 21% 对 10%。
论文没有训练或评估任何下游 SDLM，不能据此断言这些数据提升全双工模型。
project_fit: 编辑判断：更适合训练或评测 Harness 输入侧的 endpoint、overlap、barge-in 与 backchannel 检测器，而不是生成组件。
编辑判断：当前 Harness 判停后才生成，无法直接利用真实同时说话来产出回复；数据也不含晚注入工具轨迹，输出仍应交给外挂 TTS。
limitations: 生成式分离、diarization 和启发式阈值会带来串音、说话人交换与修复伪影，日语 speaker consistency 尤其偏低。
英语只处理约 2% 可用 feed，公开 URL 会失效，本地重建预计需要约 20.7TB 存储及 GPU。
源播客版权与节目条款各异；MIT 只覆盖代码和重建元数据，不授予底层音频权利。

open_source.note: 管线与 792MB manifest 公开，数据页为 https://huggingface.co/datasets/sarulab-speech/DuplexChat；音频不分发。DialogueSidon 为 CC BY-NC 4.0，pyannote 模型需接受访问条件，未发布用该语料训练的 SDLM。

3327bbf388.tl_dr: Moshi-Face 在 Moshi 的双向音频流旁加入 12.5Hz 的双向 3D 人脸 token 流，使模型连续接收用户声音与面部运动，并同步生成助手语音和面部动作。
3327bbf388.problem: 原生全双工语音模型缺少面对面交流所需的表情与口型；传统 talking-face 系统又通常依赖已经生成完的音频，不能在持续对话中联合生成。
3327bbf388.method: 系统先用 VQ-VAE 将 25fps FLAME 网格压成每帧 8 个离散 face token，再新增 Face Transformer，结合 Moshi 的 RQ-Transformer 隐状态、文本和音频 token 并行预测面部 token。训练先冻结语音主干预训练 Face Transformer，再联合微调语音与面部分支。
workflow: 从 Seamless Interaction 取约 180 小时双人对话，以 VHAP 提取 5,143 顶点的 FLAME 网格。
用约 70 小时数据训练 face codec，经 2 倍降采样得到 12.5Hz、每帧 8 个 token。
在用户/助手文本与音频流之外加入用户输入和助手输出的人脸 token 流。
Face Transformer 读取语音主干状态并同步生成助手面部 token，最后解码为 25fps 网格。
findings: Table 1 中采用的 K=256、C=128 codec 的 normalized perplexity 为 0.66，MVE/LVE 为 9.90×10⁻³/11.77×10⁻³。
Table 2 中 teacher-forced Moshi-Face 的 LSE-D/LSE-C 为 8.76/0.14，free-run 为 11.0/0.16。
Table 2 中 Moshi-Face 的 UTMOS 为 1.75，低于原始 Moshi 的 3.08；LLMAJ overall 为 3.76，对照为 3.85。
移除 Face Transformer 预训练后 LSE-D 从 8.76 变为 9.53；移除联合微调后为 11.8，overall 降到 3.23。
project_fit: 编辑判断：当前 Harness 在 endpoint 后才生成且使用外挂 TTS，无法提供 Moshi-Face 所需的 12.5Hz 模型内双向音频/面部流，不能据此称为模型级全双工。
编辑判断：若座舱需要虚拟形象，短期更现实的是让外挂 TTS 驱动级联动画；这不等同于论文利用语音主干隐藏状态联合生成面部动作。
limitations: face codec 是非因果的，论文把改用 causal streaming codec 列为未来工作。
未做真人感知评测，音频与面部同步也只能渲染成 2D 视频后用 SyncNet 间接评价。
在较小领域数据上联合微调明显降低了语音 UTMOS。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 未找到 Moshi-Face 专属代码、face codec/Face Transformer 权重、处理后数据或项目许可证；公开的 Moshi、Seamless Interaction 和 VHAP 只是上游依赖。

44a67a536b.tl_dr: 该工作不是语音回复模型，而是每秒读取对话音频、预测高低层 speech act，并用 Graph-of-Thoughts 生成自然语言理由的流式行为感知器。
44a67a536b.problem: 端到端双工模型通常直接预测下一段或下一组 token，缺少可审计的“感知行为—推断意图—决定动作”中间层。
44a67a536b.method: 系统冻结 HuBERT、Whisper/T5 等编码器，用因果 Transformer 预测四类高层和四类低层行为；再将增量转写的 OpenIE 节点与 speech-act 节点组成图，经 GAT 和音频/文本特征融合后由 T5 生成逐秒 rationale。
workflow: 将 16kHz 音频切成 1 秒块，只读取当前及历史窗口。
融合 HuBERT 声学特征和 Whisper→T5 语义特征，预测两级对话行为。
对增量转写执行 OpenIE，并把行为与文本实体关系写入逐秒图。
GAT 聚合图证据，T5 decoder 生成当前行为的解释。
findings: Table 3 中 CANDOR 的 turn-taking、backchannel、continuation AUC 分别为 0.796、0.701、0.720。
Table 4 中合成集高层 macro-F1/macro-AUC 为 0.546/0.822，低层为 0.660/0.915。
Table 5 中 Synthetic 的 BLEU-1/ROUGE-1/ROUGE-L/SIM 为 0.480/0.470/0.420/0.520，CANDOR 为 0.580/0.560/0.490/0.660。
Appendix Table 10 中严格零 look-ahead、30 秒窗口的四项 rationale 指标为 0.2899/0.2709/0.2216/0.3299；加入 10 秒未来信息后升至 0.4121/0.3988/0.3485/0.4519。
project_fit: 编辑判断：可把标签体系用作 Harness 的流式旁路感知器，在 endpoint 时将行为与 rationale 注入生成或工具决策。
编辑判断：论文不生成回复语音也不控制 TTS；当前 Harness 若仍只在 endpoint 后消费标签，依旧不能在用户讲话时附和、抢话或形成模型级全双工。
limitations: 离散 speech-act 标签不能完整表达连续、模糊且受文化影响的真实对话行为。
系统依赖上游 ASR 与 OpenIE，论文承认噪声环境和转写错误会降低鲁棒性。
正文、Table 6 与 Appendix A.8 的人评数字互相冲突，且最佳消融使用未来 10 秒信息，不能作为严格在线结果。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 官方仓库只有静态项目页、演示音频和 rationale JSON，无训练/推理代码、权重、192 小时合成语料或 LICENSE；OpenReview 投稿状态为 withdrawn。

f65775c8d2.tl_dr: 论文对比用户流直接融合进生成序列的 CF-Duplex 与独立 cross-attention memory 的 XA-Duplex：前者问答和打断更强，后者在漏停后更能隔离重叠语音污染。
f65775c8d2.problem: 普通 LLM 只延展单一序列，而原生全双工模型生成时仍要接收用户音频并决定继续、停说、响应或忽略附和；不同路由会在语义耦合和上下文隔离间取舍。
f65775c8d2.method: 共同骨架由冻结 Qwen3-1.7B、LoRA、流式 Whisper 编码器、CosyVoice2 tokenizer 和轻量 audio head 构成。CF 将用户语音、助手文本和助手音频按时间轴门控融合；XA 在偶数层插入 14 层 cross-attention，将用户流保留为独立 KV memory。WAIT 与 INT token 显式监督等待和打断。
workflow: 用大规模 ASR/TTS 和约 190 万合成轮次样本训练基础流式能力。
动态插入相关/无关打断和 backchannel，随机化反应延迟。
用户音频持续分块编码，经 CF 融合或 XA memory 注入。
主干同时预测等待/打断、文本和本地音频 token。
findings: Table 1 中 CF/XA 的 LLaMAQ speech 分别为 50.7/38.3，WebQ 为 28.0/18.4，说明独立 memory 的语义能力明显更弱。
FDB v1.5 中 CF/XA 对 interruption 的 Respond 比例为 0.72/0.32，stop latency 为 0.74/1.18 秒。
FDB v1.5 backchannel 中 CF/XA 的 Resume 比例为 0.96/0.86，stop latency 为 0.60/0.62 秒。
Table 5 中去掉 interrupt token 后 Respond 从 0.72 降至 0.56，stop latency 从 0.74 秒升至 1.90 秒。
project_fit: 编辑判断：这项权衡只在“生成期间持续把用户流送进模型”时直接成立；可作为 Harness 未来升级原生并行输入的架构依据。
编辑判断：当前 Harness 在 endpoint 后才生成，用户流不会以相同方式污染生成序列；打断主要是取消生成和外挂 TTS 队列控制，晚注入工具也不在论文范围。
limitations: 只比较两种路由、单一 1.7B 尺度和固定训练配方，CF/XA 参数量也不严格匹配。
训练大量依赖合成 TTS、拼接和插入行为，没有端到端 RTF、显存或目标设备首音频实测。
XA 漏停后更连贯主要是少量定性案例，未报告完整失败样本数和量化连贯率。

open_source.note: 官方 https://light1726.github.io/duplex-demo/ 只提供静态演示与音频；未找到训练/推理代码、CF/XA 权重、专属数据或发布许可证，论文附录明确投稿时不公开模型。

0483feb407.tl_dr: LMPAN 是 480K 参数的 DSP+神经网络声学前端，通过三路软时延/能量对齐、双分支增强和动态目标联合做 AEC 与降噪，重点保住强回声下的近端用户语音。
0483feb407.problem: 扬声器非线性、房间变化和硬件时延会让播放参考、麦克风与线性 AEC 残差信号错位；过强抑制又会误删近端语音，破坏 VAD、ASR 和真实打断。
0483feb407.method: 系统先用子带互相关和 NLMS 得到线性 AEC 输出，再对 ref-mic、mic-LAEC、ref-LAEC 三条路径做最大 1 秒的概率时延对齐与可学习能量缩放。两个 GTCRN 分支分别细化 LAEC 与麦克风频谱，注意力融合复数 mask；Dynamic Target Adaptation 有意保留少量噪声/回声，训练再结合 WavLM 表示损失。
workflow: 采集麦克风与外部播放 reference，执行线性 AEC。
对三对频谱估计软时延分布并补偿能量失配。
双 GTCRN 分支增强 LAEC 与麦克风信号，再由注意力 mask 融合。
输出增强音频，交给下游 VAD、ASR、endpoint 和对话管理。
findings: Table 1 中不含 DTA 的两阶段模型为 0.48M 参数、126M MACs，MOS_avg 4.49；加入 DTA 后为 4.44。
Table 2 在 SER −20…−15dB 时，一阶段基线 DCF/WER/TIR 为 9.38/24.25/85.17%，完整 STL+DTA 为 3.75/14.38/93.85%。
Table 3 中目标 SER 25dB 得到最低 WER 10.24%，而最高 ERLE 45.11dB 出现在 35dB，说明 ASR 最优不等于回声抑制最强。
论文没有报告手机上的端到端延迟、RTF、内存或功耗，不能仅凭参数量认定可实时上车。
project_fit: 编辑判断：可放在 Harness 的 VAD/endpoint/ASR 前，直接把外挂 TTS 的真实播放波形作为 far-end reference，提升回声下插话保留率。
编辑判断：它不让 LLM 边听边生成，也不处理取消生成、TTS 队列、状态恢复或晚注入工具；应定位为 AEC/NS 候选而非全双工模型。
limitations: 40 部手机数据和 4,000 条真实测试音频未公开，设备、房间、语言与说话人构成也不充分。
最大对齐范围为 1 秒，但模拟训练只明确注入 0–80ms 平移，对更长动态时延的覆盖未知。
真实测试只覆盖两个极低 SER 区间，TIR 还依赖特定 LLM-enhanced dialogue management。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 未找到官方项目页、LMPAN 代码、权重或专属数据许可证；上游 AEC/DNS Challenge 和 WavLM 的开放状态不能替代本方法发布。

0cfb27f5b9.tl_dr: 这篇综述用 L0–L3 决策层级、T×I×R 交互本体和五状态机拆解“全双工”，并强调架构上可表达某行为不等于训练后已经实现。
0cfb27f5b9.problem: “级联/端到端”等单轴分类不能说明双工决策发生在哪一层，也无法区分打断、附和、犹豫、持续重叠和第三方语音。
0cfb27f5b9.method: 论文从音频进入 LLM 的路线和 tokenizer 粒度出发，将系统按决策位置分成 L0 外部控制、L1 隐状态预测、L2 token-level 和尚未实现的 L3 shared latent；再以时间关系、用户意图、系统响应三元组和 Idle/Listen/Speak/Wait/Dual 状态机审计系统、语料与基准。
workflow: 检查每类系统的输入表示、同步粒度和双工决策位置。
把交互映射为时间关系 T、用户意图 I、系统响应 R 的三元组。
将三元组落入五状态、十一转换的可观察状态机。
对照系统论文、公开语料和评测，定位架构能力与实测行为之间的 realization gap。
findings: Table 2 审计列出 L0/L1/L2/L3 代表系统分别为 4/2/9/0 个，只有 L2 被标为五种状态全部原生可达。
Table 3 的 T、I、R 分别有 5、7、6 类，形成 210 个名义交互单元，论文选出 6 个 acid-test cells。
Table 4 的状态机包含 5 个状态和 11 条转换；稳定持续重叠的 Dual self-loop 未计入。
Table 5–6 汇总 9 个代表公开语料、约 5,000 小时；五个重点语料中持续 concurrent 覆盖为 0/5，第三方语音仅 1/5 部分覆盖。
project_fit: 编辑判断：当前 Harness 是流式输入、endpoint 后生成的 L0-shaped half-duplex pipeline；流式 KV 不等于模型能在听的同时产生因果输出。
编辑判断：应分别报告 endpoint、外挂 TTS 首包/取消、工具注入和控制器延迟，而不是用“streaming input”笼统宣称 full duplex。
limitations: 系统能力和交互单元覆盖主要来自原论文自报，没有逐个端到端复现，部分工业系统也闭源。
框架按现有 L0–L2 系统校准，L3 方案仍是推测，未来架构可能要求扩展本体与状态机。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 官方仓库公开 README、图表和六段演示，但没有审计/评测代码、模型、权重或第一方数据，两个相关仓库均无 LICENSE。

35477e429c.tl_dr: VideoFDB 用自然双人视频通话测试智能体能否持续利用凝视、表情、动作和语音管理对话，并显示现有 AV2A 模型常忽略视频或退化为视觉描述。
35477e429c.problem: 语音全双工基准不测视觉信号，传统视频 QA 又不评价连续重叠对话中的时机、让权和非语言反馈。
35477e429c.method: 基准从双路视频通话标注 11 类 conversational dynamics，为每个事件保留上下文、目标时间窗与 judge caption；实时重放用户音视频后，以 0–5 rubric 评价感知/生成质量，并用 TOR-Alignment 判断 stay-silent、yield、handoff 等时序策略。
workflow: 从本地双路录制的自然视频通话中发现并人工质检候选互动事件。
保留事件前 1–3 个 turn 和最多一个后续 turn，标注动态类型与时间窗。
向模型实时流式输入用户音视频，记录输出、ASR、时间戳和音视频 caption。
按动态专属 rubric 评分，并计算五类 timing policy 的 TOR-Alignment 与延迟。
findings: Appendix Tables 6–7 给出 237 个评测行、11 类 dynamics、130 位说话者；test/validation 为 226/11。
Table 3 中人类 Overall 为 4.20，最佳非人类 AV2A MiniCPM-o 4.5 为 3.40。
同表中 MiniCPM-o、Gemini 3.1、gpt-realtime 加视频后分别为 3.40/2.84/2.75，低于各自 audio-only 的 3.44/3.03/2.97。
Table 4 中人类非语言反馈适当性为 3.18、时序命中 78%/900ms；Anam 为 1.71、44%/2840ms，Keyframe 为 1.13、31%/3520ms。
project_fit: 编辑判断：若 Harness 没有连续视频输入和视觉输出，generation track 不适用；只能借用部分 AV2A/A2A 感知协议。
编辑判断：endpoint 后才生成且外挂 TTS 的架构无法在用户 turn 内独立产生视觉/语音反馈；可借 TOR-Alignment 测整条 pipeline，但不能宣称模型级全双工。
limitations: 数据仅覆盖英语、美国/加拿大参与者和双人 webcam 视频会议，不代表多语、移动端或多人面对面互动。
基准只支持 single-turn evaluation，不提供多轮训练或微调。
LM judge 依赖上游音视频 caption，系统 prompt 也不总能覆盖模型预训练出的问候行为。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 约 4.8GB 数据已人工门控发布，但受 NVIDIA Evaluation License 限制；评测代码、Space 和 judge 权重尚未公开，237 行对应 180 个唯一 sample_id。

5e1773f2f1.tl_dr: RelayS2S 让小型双工 S2S 模型先给出经 verifier 审核的约 5 词前缀，同时让 ASR→强 LLM 从同一前缀续写，以快路径启动速度换取慢路径回答质量。
5e1773f2f1.problem: 端到端 S2S 启动快但语义较弱，级联 ASR→LLM 质量高却随后端模型变大而增加首段生成延迟。
5e1773f2f1.method: 快路径在检测到 BOS/BOC 后分叉出自由解码的投机流，约 170K 参数 verifier 根据 hidden state、熵、log-probability 和 top-two margin 决定提交或回退；慢 LLM 被约束为从已经播放的精确前缀继续，最终统一交给 streaming TTS。
workflow: 每 160ms 编码用户语音并预测 SIL、BOS、BOC 或 STP。
决定发言时并行启动快路径前缀和 ASR→LLM 慢路径。
verifier 审核投机前缀，通过则立即送 TTS，否则完全回退慢路径。
慢 LLM 从已提交前缀续写；持续监听的主分支在 STP 时停止播放。
findings: Table 2 中 GPT-4o 后端 RelayS2S P90 为 81ms，级联为 1,091ms，纯 S2S 为 71ms；该口径不含 TTS、网络和 turn detection。
同表中 RelayS2S/级联平均质量为 4.78/4.83，低质量率为 7.4%/5.5%。
Table 3 中 BOS/SIL/STP/BOC F1 为 88.5/99.8/96.7/50.8。
Table 4 中 verifier AUROC 为 0.90；阈值 0.50 时 good commit 96.3%、bad commit 45.7%、fallback 8.0%。
project_fit: 编辑判断：当前 Harness 可在 endpoint 后并行运行“小模型前缀+大模型续写”，但无法复现论文边听边附和和 barge-in 的模型级双工路径。
编辑判断：晚注入工具与早提交事实性前缀冲突；工具结果确定前只能允许无命题短开场，且必须重测 endpoint→首个可听音频。
limitations: 前缀越长低质量率越高，默认阈值仍提交 45.7% 的坏前缀。
backchannel F1 只有 50.8，说明最难的交互时机仍不稳定。
81ms 延迟排除了 endpoint、网络与 TTS，且只在单张 L40S 上测量，不是用户听到声音的端到端延迟。

open_source.note: 代码、约 227GB 数据和主要 checkpoint 已公开，但 README 明示 live interactive inference 尚未发布，仓库缺完整实时编排/streaming TTS，GitHub 与 HF 均无明确许可证。

137d033275.tl_dr: Sympatheia 在 GLM-4-Voice-9B 上用 LoRA 学习连续 valence–arousal 条件，使回答内容和模型原生语音随用户情绪变化，并统一接收面部、生理或文本情绪模块输出的 VA。
137d033275.problem: 日常语音的情绪线索常弱、模糊或混合，离散情绪标签难表达强度、连续变化和个体差异。
137d033275.method: 系统将可选的 valence/arousal 数值写入 system prompt；没有显式 VA 时从用户语音推断。GLM-4-Voice 生成文本和语音 token，streaming flow-matching decoder 还原波形；Sympatheia-18k 以 12 个情绪锚点训练语义与声学适配。
workflow: WhisperVQ 将用户音频编码为 12.5Hz 单码本 speech token。
可选面部、EEG/ECG/GSR 或文本模块输出类别分布并映射为连续 VA。
把 VA 写入 system prompt，LoRA 适配的 GLM-4-Voice 生成文本与语音 token。
流匹配解码器生成波形；没有外部 VA 时依赖输入语音自身的情绪线索。
findings: Table 1 中 Sympatheia 的 Neutral/Emotional/VoiceBench/人工 Emotion MOS 为 4.37/4.74/4.22/3.86，Qwen3-Omni 为 2.59/4.69/1.88/3.32。
Appendix Table 11 中显式 VA 将 Neutral 从 1.883 提升到 4.368，VoiceBench 从 1.690 提升到 4.224。
Table 3 中离线面部线索为 3.64、无 cue 为 1.92；现场面部为 3.39/1.98，文本描述为 3.57/1.63。
project_fit: 编辑判断：Harness 可在 endpoint 后把 VA 注入 system prompt，但论文的韵律增益来自原生语音 decoder；外挂 TTS 只有同时支持 VA/style 才能保留声学效果。
编辑判断：若把情绪传感器作为晚注入工具，应在首 token 前完成；该方案仍是 endpoint 后条件生成，不应称为模型级全双工。
limitations: 合成数据无法充分覆盖真实口误、说话人差异和长程情绪动态。
单个 VA 点不能完整表示混合、快速变化及受文化/个体影响的情绪。
评测高度依赖自动音频 LLM judge，数据、TTS 和 judge 同属 Qwen3 系列，可能存在模型家族偏差。
上游情绪识别尤其是生理信号容易出错，并带来隐私、同意和公平风险。

open_source.note: 训练、推理、评测代码、约 1.19GB LoRA 和 18,000 对数据已公开；adapter 仍依赖 GLM-4-Voice 专用许可与额外 decoder 权重，GitHub 根目录也缺独立 LICENSE。

3f92468717.tl_dr: OmniInteract 把连续音视频助手评测表示为带时间边界的 interaction slots，联合衡量系统是否回答、何时回答和回答什么。
3f92468717.problem: 离线视频 QA、文本提问或预切片输入无法测试语音触发、主动响应、中断、嵌套恢复和长时任务监控。
3f92468717.method: 每个 slot 定义起点、允许作答时刻、终点、目标答案和中断属性；系统按原始时间戳在线接收音视频，输出再映射回 slot，分别评价过早输出、核心答案、延迟、spillover 和上下文恢复，并汇总 IA-QTF1、IDS、NCCS。
workflow: 按原始时间戳重放音频和视频，禁止模型读取未来内容。
将实时、主动、嵌套和 1QnA 事件标成 trigger/window/answer slots。
按输出起始时间匹配 slot，并在允许作答时刻切分 early/core 内容。
用 judge 判断过早幻觉、核心答案和中断部分，再聚合 IA-QTF1、IDS、NCCS。
findings: Table 2 中 250 个视频包含 1,430 个 slots：638 real-time、184 proactive、240 nested、368 1QnA，并有 192 个中断案例。
Table 3 中最佳总 IA-QTF1 仅 0.368，最佳 1QnA 为 0.052；1Q1A global 最佳为 0.467。
Table 4 中最佳 NCCS 为 0.284；Gemini 和 Qwen 分别漏掉 119/120 与 116/120 个外层恢复。
Table 6 中 MiniCPM-o 数学推理质量从离线 0.6833 降到在线 0.3475，绝对下降 0.3358。
project_fit: 编辑判断：slot 和 IA-QTF1 可用于 Harness，但 endpoint 后才生成意味着 proactive、边听边说、中断和 nested-resume 不能按原论文能力宣称通过。
编辑判断：外挂 TTS 的起止、取消和 spill 应计入系统级时序；晚注入工具可另建事件 slot，但必须与论文原分数分开。
limitations: 论文只评估四个模型，在线能力退化实验也只覆盖 MiniCPM-o 数学任务。
1QnA 初始指令使用 TTS，与自然录制的 1Q1A 存在输入难度差异。
语言和领域只覆盖中文日常场景与英文数学推理。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 评测适配器、slot/judge/指标代码及 8.38GB 数据已公开；代码仓库无顶层许可证，完整四模型复现还依赖商业 API 和外部模型，数据为 CC BY-NC 4.0。

f90b0bcb1d.tl_dr: S-MARC 是每秒预测对话行为并生成证据化理由的严格因果流式 sidecar，不是端到端语音回复模型。
f90b0bcb1d.problem: 双向对话模型常直接预测下一段或双 token，缺少显式的“沟通功能—交互行为”推理层，也难以低延迟解释打断、接话或保持沉默的原因。
f90b0bcb1d.method: 系统融合每 0.5 秒更新的流式 ASR 和声学特征，先预测高层 communicative function，再以 duration-conditioned belief state 预测低层 interaction behavior；稳定句子与当前 tick 组成 90 秒因果图，选择历史证据后由 seq2seq decoder 生成 rationale。
workflow: 把 16kHz 音频切成 1 秒 tick，并持续更新增量 ASR。
融合文本/声学特征，预测四类高层功能和五类低层行为。
用持续时间 belief state 抑制秒级标签抖动。
在 90 秒因果窗口选择历史锚点，线性化证据链并生成 rationale。
findings: Table 5 中完整模型 H-Ack F1/AUC 为 0.546/0.837，低层 Interruption 为 0.386/0.851，推理延迟为 0.101s。
移除 CausalEvidenceTrunk 后 H-Directive F1 从 0.534 降到 0.098，L-Continuation 从 0.824 降到 0.369。
Table 7 中 GoT rationale 延迟为 0.74±0.12s，GPT-4o 为 2.98±1.04s，GPT-5 thinking 为 16.98±5.29s。
Appendix Table 10 中单 RTX A6000 的 input-to-rationale 平均/steady-state/p95 为 0.8249/0.8361/1.0491s。
project_fit: 编辑判断：每秒 causal perceiver 可作为 Harness 的 endpoint、打断或 backchannel sidecar，但不能替换 endpoint 后的生成链路。
编辑判断：若 Harness 在生成期间不继续监听，它仍不是论文意义上的模型级全双工；论文也未覆盖晚注入工具和外挂 TTS。
limitations: GoT 计算复杂度限制实时图的深度、规模和更新频率。
模拟对话比真人有更密集的微分段、更多停顿和更短 overlap，不能等同于真实时序分布。
Candor 上正常 turn-taking 边界仍容易与 backchannel/continuation 混淆。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 未找到可取得的 S-MARC 实现、checkpoint 或 ConversationGoT-120h 数据；关联项目页只有静态演示且无 LICENSE，arXiv supplementary source 也不含代码。

5fceaa2ebd.tl_dr: DuplexGen 用少量、slot 级人类偏好分布校准 LLM，再按场景合成带 BACKCHANNEL 和 TAKE_FLOOR 的对话数据，用于微调原生全双工语音模型。
5fceaa2ebd.problem: 人类语音语料缺少任务角色和场景规范，规则或 prompt 合成又没有验证目标场景偏好，导致模型对教学、谈判和闲聊采用同一种轮替策略。
5fceaa2ebd.method: 系统在六类场景中把五名标注者对“继续听/附和/抢话”的投票作为软标签，以 KL 损失校准 Qwen3；随后按预测分布插入 backchannel 或截断当前话轮，TTS 渲染后用于 PersonaPlex 微调。
workflow: 将文本对话改写为含 filler、重复和自我修正的口语体。
结合标点、停顿词、LLM 边界和最长 8-token 规则确定候选 slot。
每个 slot 收集五人偏好分布，先用 Switchboard 预训练再做场景 LoRA 校准。
按校准概率插入附和或抢占话轮，渲染语音后微调 PersonaPlex。
findings: Figure 3 中六场景 backchannel 比例为 0.23–0.32，floor-taking 为 0.05–0.12，绝大多数跨场景差异在 Holm 校正后显著。
Table 6 中 Qwen3-4B 的 SWBD+DuplexGen 平均 KL 为 0.335±0.009，优于 prompt-only 0.458±0.009 和 SWBD-only 0.752±0.012。
Table 7 中人类竞争−合作的 floor/backchannel 差为 +0.056/−0.053，SWBD+DG 为 +0.052/−0.062，prompt-only 仅 +0.008/+0.011。
project_fit: 编辑判断：可复用三分类标签、slot 格式和场景差异做 Harness 的离线数据与回归设计，但它不是可直接接入的运行时组件。
编辑判断：Harness 只有 endpoint 后生成，无法在用户仍讲话时 backchannel 或 take-floor；晚注入工具和外挂 TTS 也会把文本决策与真实声学时序分离。
limitations: 只覆盖六种场景，交互类型和社会规范的多样性有限。
PersonaPlex 行为对数据及 turn-switch latency、pause duration、learning rate 等超参数敏感。
校准只看增量文本，没有使用韵律、重叠、视觉信号，也未证明文本偏好与音频条件偏好一致。

open_source.note: 文本/标注和约 705GB 语音数据已公开；两个 GitHub 仓库仍只有 README，六个 PP-DG checkpoint、训练实现和统一许可证未发布，论文与数据卡对 PER 子集许可还有冲突。

6632215e09.tl_dr: FacePlex 以 PersonaPlex 为语音主干，每 80ms 联合输出一个语音块和两个 FLAME 面部帧，用滚动流匹配与交叉注意力保持在线同步。
6632215e09.problem: 全双工语音模型没有面部输出，而普通 talking-face 模型依赖预先给定的完整音频，无法在持续对话中联合生成声音与表情。
6632215e09.method: Rolling Flow Matching 维护错位 flow-time 的运动队列并逐步精炼，Rolling Cross-Attention 让待输出运动读取近期隐藏状态和短暂预测语音；默认长度 4 的队列每步输出两个 108D FLAME 帧。
workflow: PersonaPlex 持续接收用户音频，每 80ms 生成 4096 维 hidden state 和预测语音块。
维护长度 4 的音频、hidden-state 和 motion 队列。
RFM 并行推进各 motion slot 的 flow time，RCA 注入近期和短暂未来预测语音。
最前端语音块与两个面部帧同步出队并渲染。
findings: Table 2 中 FacePlex 的 turn/interruption latency 为 0.078/0.399s，PersonaPlex 为 0.078/0.427s。
同表中 FacePlex PLRS 为 0.239，表中音频驱动基线最佳为 0.208。
Table 3 的 25 人研究中 Lip Sync/Natural & Coherence/Interaction/MOS 为 3.592/3.624/3.920/3.736，第二高总体 MOS 为 3.080。
Appendix Table 6 中 N=2/4/8/16 Euler steps 的 motion forward latency 为 7.909/15.465/30.647/62.261ms；不含语音主干、编解码和渲染。
project_fit: 编辑判断：FacePlex 依赖模型级持续监听与 80ms 语音生成；当前 Harness 在 endpoint 后才生成，架构不兼容。
编辑判断：外挂 TTS 无法提供 PersonaPlex 的内部隐藏状态和待播放预测语音，最多只能在 TTS 输出后做普通 audio-driven animation。
limitations: 主要评价 FLAME 参数而非照片级视频，没有覆盖身份保持、光照和渲染伪影。
listener motion 一对多，距离指标只能部分衡量语义与情绪适当性。
合成 self-play 和 UniLS teacher 可能传递偏差，且不生成 gaze、身体/手部动作或长期 persona。
正文称联合端到端训练，附录却称冻结 PersonaPlex 并预缓存 hidden states，训练描述存在矛盾。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 官方仓库只有项目网页与演示媒体；核心训练/推理/评测代码、FacePlex 权重和约 1,138 小时处理后数据均未发布，网页许可证不能覆盖未发布模型。

e772de8f55.tl_dr: Wan-Streamer v0.1 用一个 Transformer 原生联合处理并生成文本、音频和 192p 视频，以严格因果流实现持续感知、同步音视频输出和可打断交互。
e772de8f55.problem: ASR→LLM→TTS→avatar 级联系统存在模块等待、误差累积及音画/轮次不同步，工程优化也不能把非因果组件变成模型级全双工。
e772de8f55.method: 模型用因果音视频 VAE、block-causal attention、文本 next-token loss 和音视频联合 conditional flow matching，把多模态输入输出交错为一条序列；滚动蒸馏后以 thinker–performer 双 GPU 流水线重叠状态更新、latent 生成与解码。
workflow: 将当前用户文本、音频和视频编码为可立即消费的因果流式单元。
Transformer 用完整历史更新语言/交互状态并预测文本。
performer 基于共享 KV 历史联合去噪下一音视频 latent。
clean latent 写回历史，thinker 解码上一单元并发出，同时继续接收用户输入。
findings: Section 2.4 与 Table 1 给出的流式单元为 160ms，视频输出为 25fps。
编码、状态更新、latent 生成到解码的模型侧 signal-to-signal 延迟约 200ms。
加入论文假设的 350ms 双向网络预算后，总交互延迟约 550ms。
Section 5 明确 v0.1 只在初步 192p 输出上验证，正文没有标准质量指标、人评或消融。
project_fit: 编辑判断：Wan-Streamer 是模型内部持续感知与生成，当前 Harness 是流式输入、endpoint 后生成和外挂 TTS，二者不能等同。
编辑判断：论文未讨论工具调用且没有可接入资产，只适合作为长期目标架构；Harness 应单列 endpoint、工具、首文本、首 TTS 音频和网络延迟。
limitations: 192p 只是 proof of concept，更高分辨率仍是未来工作。
实时吞吐要求 performer 加通信开销小于 160ms，200ms 结果依赖特定双 GPU 路径。
论文没有公开标准化质量指标、人评或消融，并提醒竞品延迟口径并不一致。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 https://wan-streamer.com/v0.1/ 只提供论文和演示；Wan 官方 GitHub/Hugging Face 中未找到专属代码、权重、训练数据或许可证。

11df86e01c.tl_dr: AV-Dialog 用嘴唇视觉和保留声纹的 DAC token，在噪声及多人干扰下流式跟踪目标说话者、转写并预测何时接话；dual 版本再由文本 LLM 和外挂 Mimi TTS 回复。
11df86e01c.problem: 纯音频对话模型在鸡尾酒会环境中容易跟错说话者，造成错误响应和不自然轮替。
11df86e01c.method: 每 40ms 输入 16 路 DAC codebook 与 AV-HuBERT 唇部特征，LLaMA3-8B 预测目标转写和 normal/overlap/backchannel 事件。dual 架构把结果流入第二个文本 LLM，再交给 Mimi TTS；unified 架构在同一模型输出 turn-event 与文本回复。
workflow: 用 dlib 定位人脸，AV-HuBERT 提取唇部特征，DAC 编码音频。
AV understanding LLaMA3-8B 流式输出目标用户转写和 turn-event。
dual 模式在 LISTENING 时更新文本 LLM KV，turn token 到达后进入 SPEAKING。
响应中检测到新用户语音则让权并回到 LISTENING，文本交给外挂 Mimi TTS。
findings: Table 1 中 A+V 在 Clean/BG/Interf 的 WER 为 17.4/35.6/38.8%，Auto-AVSR 为 26.8/48.2/71.8%。
Table 5 的 18 人研究中 Dual+ICL N-MOS/H-MOS 为 4.14/4.09，SE+Moshi 为 2.39/2.10，Unified 为 3.54/3.02。
Table 8 中 unified 加 turn supervision 后三条件响应比例为 68.1/75.6/75.9%，移除后为 48.0/35.1/38.0%。
project_fit: 编辑判断：dual 架构与 Harness 的外挂 TTS 有交集，可借鉴视听说话人跟踪和语义 turn token；但 Harness 等 endpoint 后才生成，不能声称同等流式轮替。
编辑判断：论文没有工具调用证据；晚注入工具可能改变首响应和连贯性，必须把 endpoint、工具执行和 TTS 分段评测。
limitations: 模型不显式处理笑声、叹气等非语言音频，视觉也基本限于嘴唇，不理解表情和手势。
弱光、嘴部遮挡和极端头部姿态会损害目标跟踪与识别。
AV-HuBERT 两帧 look-ahead 使算法延迟约 120ms；dual 还需同时运行两个约 8B 模型。
指定 arXiv v1 与官网后续版本的人评样本数和 MOS 增益不同，本站数字严格采用 v1。

open_source.note: 截至 2026-08-04 https://avdialog.cs.washington.edu/ 的官方代码链接返回 404，未找到权重、处理后数据或软件许可证；Seamless Interaction 等上游数据不足以复现系统。

568f96feb9.tl_dr: Metronome 用“最近 W 个 token 加固定 attention sinks”的有界 KV 和逐帧延迟驱动的 AIMD 准入控制，避免实时交互模型长期驻留时突然耗尽 KV block pool。
568f96feb9.problem: 逐帧接收音频并持续 prefill/decode 的会话会让 KV 单调增长并长期驻留；block pool 饱和后所有请求会一起等待，而空帧仍按时返回，使常规延迟指标看不见服务已失活。
568f96feb9.method: 系统在 vLLM decoder 启用滑动窗口，只保留最近 W 个 token，并固定最前 S 个 attention-sink token 以减轻窗口滑动后的生成退化。Gateway 按 frame budget 批量 Step，再依据逐帧实际延迟运行 AIMD admission controller；负载有余量时加性提高并发，接近目标时乘性降低。
workflow: 客户端持续发送小音频块，Gateway 按帧预算合并到期会话。
GPU worker 对长期 resumable request 做小段 prefill 和有限 decode。
KV manager 释放窗口前 block，同时保留 sink block。
Gateway 用逐帧延迟更新准入上限，超过容量的会话直接拒绝。
findings: Figure 4 与 Appendix Table 1 中，5 分钟测试的无界 KV 共 14/20 次撞墙，窗口 KV 为 0/20。
Figure 6 中 Qwen3-Omni-30B 饱和时间预测 145 秒、实测 148 秒；MiniCPM-o 预测 99 秒、实测 114 秒。
Figure 7 中以 8 sessions/s 提供 512 个会话时，控制器收敛到约 209 个并发，稳态 p99 为 12ms。
Appendix Table 2 中两种策略的 turn-based QA 均为 96/96 会话答对，但 W=512、S=32 的连续生成质量会退化到 0%，窗口过小不能靠 sink 补救。
project_fit: 编辑判断：当前 Harness 在 endpoint 后才生成，通常没有论文所述每帧自回归 KV 无限增长；仍应对长历史和晚注入工具后的上下文设置上限，并做分钟级压力测试。
编辑判断：若未来改为长期 resumable generation，再引入 per-session KV window、活性指标和 admission control；不能直接套用论文的 209 会话容量。
limitations: 实验只用一张 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell，admission 与质量实验主要只覆盖 Qwen3-Omni-30B。
多数容量和 MiniCPM 长时实验是单次 fresh run，主要服务实验实际只启用 window、没有完整 sink kernel。
论文不评真实 turn-taking、barge-in 或工具调用，固定窗口也无法回忆窗口外内容。

cfbb41def0.tl_dr: FastTurn 融合 streaming CTC 部分转写、Conformer 声学表示和 Qwen3-0.6B 语义状态，判断 Complete、Incomplete、Backchannel、Wait；它是判停器，不是语音生成模型。
cfbb41def0.problem: 纯 VAD 不懂停顿与语义，完整 ASR→文本模型级联又增加延迟并在重叠和噪声下退化；判停器需要同时利用尽早出现的转写前缀和韵律声学线索。
cfbb41def0.method: 约 80M 的 12 层 Conformer 运行流式 CTC，部分转写被包装为 prompt 送入 Qwen3-0.6B。四层 LLM adapter 将声学表示映射到语言 embedding，另一个 acoustic adapter 保留细粒度声学状态，两路融合后由三层 MLP 分类；训练依次进行语义预训练、模态对齐、联合训练和模态融合。
workflow: 对流式音频运行 Conformer 和 greedy CTC，尽早产生部分转写。
将 CTC prompt 与映射后的声学 embedding 输入 Qwen3-0.6B。
用 prompt dropout 降低模型对错误转写的依赖。
融合声学与语言隐藏状态，输出 Complete、Incomplete、Backchannel 或 Wait。
findings: Table 1 中测试集共 22,432 条、12.92 小时，其中 Complete 14,709 条、Incomplete 3,643、Backchannel 3,080、合成 Wait 1,000。
Table 3 中 Unified 为 700M 参数、79.62% overall accuracy、120.1ms 平均延迟；Easy Turn 为 78.05%、297.1ms。
Unified 在 Smart Turn 中文集仅 76.58%/139.0ms，低于 Smart Turn 的 90.53%/70.22ms，显示明显数据域依赖。
Table 2 并不支持正文“所有类别均最佳”的宽泛表述：Easy Turn 在 Incomplete 的 accuracy/miss/FA 均更好。
project_fit: 编辑判断：与 Harness 的生成前 endpoint 最匹配，可把二元 speech/silence 扩为四状态，仅 Complete 触发生成，late tool injection 仍留在下游。
编辑判断：无代码和权重，120.1ms 的计时定义与硬件也不完整；采用其思路不会让判停后生成、外挂 TTS 的 Harness 变成原生模型级全双工。
limitations: 训练混入内部会话数据；Wait 类全由 DeepSeek V3 与 IndexTTS2 合成，且类别和时长高度不均衡。
平均延迟没有定义计时起止、batch、音频长度或推理硬件，正文也没有噪声强度和 overlap 分层结果。
未报告标注者一致性、置信区间或多次运行方差，英文子集也没有稳定超过基线。

21e7d7b562.tl_dr: Real-time multimodal agents transport raw audio and screenshots using networking stacks designed for human receivers, which optimize for perceptual fidelity and smooth playout. Yet agent models act as event-driven processors with no inheren
21e7d7b562.problem: 论文针对全双工语音或流式多模态交互中的一项具体能力缺口提出新方法。
21e7d7b562.method: Real-time multimodal agents transport raw audio and screenshots using networking stacks designed for human receivers, which optimize for perceptual fidelity and smooth playout. Yet agent models act as event-driven processors with no inherent sense of physical time, consuming task-relevant semantics rather than reconstructing signals in real time. This fundamental difference shifts the transport goal from the technical problem of signal fidelity (Shannon-Weaver Level A) to the semantic problem of meaning preservation (Level B). This mismatch imposes significant overhead. In visual pipelines, screenshot upload accounts for over 60% of end-to-end action latency on constrained uplinks, and in voice pipelines, conventional transport carries massive redundancy, sending 43-64x more data than needed to maintain task accuracy. We present Sema, a semantic transport system that combines discrete audio tokenizers with a hybrid screen representation (lossless accessibility-tree or OCR text, plus compact visual tokens) and bursty token delivery that eliminates jitter buffers. In simulations under emulated WAN conditions, Sema reduces uplink bandwidth by 64x for audio and 130-210x for screenshots while preserving task accuracy within 0.7 percentage points of the raw baseline.

2db635b47b.tl_dr: Production voice agents span cascaded, speech-to-speech, and hybrid architectures. Voice-agent benchmarks typically measure component quality and conversational properties such as word error rate, latency, naturalness, and turn-taking. Fewe
2db635b47b.problem: 论文针对全双工语音或流式多模态交互中的一项具体能力缺口提出新方法。
2db635b47b.method: Production voice agents span cascaded, speech-to-speech, and hybrid architectures. Voice-agent benchmarks typically measure component quality and conversational properties such as word error rate, latency, naturalness, and turn-taking. Fewer measure whether the agent handled a phone call correctly on its own. Contact centers refer to this as ``containment'': the share of phone calls the automated system resolves without handing off to a human. On some phone calls the right outcome is refusal or a redirect. To address this gap, we introduce VAmoS Bench, the Voice Agent Simulation Bench. It measures complete voice-agent systems end to end in a stateful customer-support task. The agent is Riley, a credit-card support representative for a fictional bank who can freeze, cancel, replace, or activate a card. Each of 100 scenarios supplies a simulated caller with a private goal and a seeded PostgreSQL backend. The platform uses each scenario to populate and activate an isolated simulation in which the caller reaches Riley over audio; roughly one-third apply adversarial pressure. The agent can use five tools that execute real SQL against the backend. Each scenario also defines binary assertions. A grader evaluates them against the complete trace of what the caller and agent said and what the agent did, including tool invocations, arguments, and returned rows. This catches an agent that claims to have changed a card without updating the database, as well as one that makes the right database change while disclosing protected information. This first benchmark version focuses on financial services. Its evaluation protocol supports an evolving leaderboard: additional voice agents can be evaluated on the same version, while later versions can expand the tasks and scenarios.

271ff71800.tl_dr: Audio-text retrieval systems based on Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP) achieve strong performance on traditional benchmarks; however, these benchmarks rely on caption-style queries that differ substantially from real-world sear
271ff71800.problem: 论文针对全双工语音或流式多模态交互中的一项具体能力缺口提出新方法。
271ff71800.method: Audio-text retrieval systems based on Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP) achieve strong performance on traditional benchmarks; however, these benchmarks rely on caption-style queries that differ substantially from real-world search behavior, limiting their assessment of practical retrieval robustness. We present Omni-Embed-Audio (OEA), a retrieval-oriented encoder leveraging multimodal LLMs with native audio understanding. To systematically evaluate robustness beyond caption-style queries, we introduce User-Intent Queries (UIQs) - five formulations reflecting natural search behaviors: questions, commands, keyword tags, paraphrases, and exclusion-based negative queries. For negative queries, we develop a hard negative mining pipeline and propose discrimination metrics (HNSR, TFR) assessing models' ability to suppress acoustically similar distractors. Experiments on AudioCaps, Clotho, and MECAT show that OEA achieves comparable text-to-audio retrieval performance to state-of-the-art M2D-CLAP, while demonstrating clear advantages in two critical areas: (1) dominant text-to-text retrieval (+22% relative improvement), and (2) substantially superior hard negative discrimination (+4.3%p HNSR@10, +34.7% relative TFR@10), revealing that LLM backbones provide superior semantic understanding of complex queries.

a52bf62ed8.tl_dr: Agentic video understanding equips models with long-term memory to autonomously process and respond to continuous, long-horizon multimodal streams. However, advanced video agents often rely on ``detective-style'' iterative reasoning for act
a52bf62ed8.problem: 仅处理语音的助手无法覆盖面对面交互中的动作、表情或连续视觉线索，跨模态时序也难以保持同步。
a52bf62ed8.method: Agentic video understanding equips models with long-term memory to autonomously process and respond to continuous, long-horizon multimodal streams. However, advanced video agents often rely on ``detective-style'' iterative reasoning for action control (e.g., $\mathtt{search}$) and evidence aggregation, incurring prohibitive costs and latency. We argue that such heavy reasoning primarily compensates for the lack of global context and semantic misalignment in retrieval. This paper introduces Light-Omni, a multimodal agent framework for reflexive and lightweight video understanding. It achieves this through dual contextual states that instantly build the required context in a single forward pass. First, we maintain a global state, a finite-sized multimodal script continuously consolidated from episodic memory, serving as the global context for Light-Omni. Through hierarchical merging, it preserves recent details while summarizing past events. Second, conditioned on this global context, we generate a parametric latent state that directly drives autonomous actions and produces retrieval embeddings, with minimal latency. Benefiting from this coupled design, Light-Omni achieves semantically aligned retrieval and reflexive responses while avoiding iterative reasoning. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of Light-Omni across multiple video benchmarks. Notably, it outperforms M3-Agent with an average 2.4% accuracy gain, a 12.1$\times$ speedup, and a 2.6$\times$ improvement in GPU memory efficiency. Furthermore, it serves as a memory system to enhance both the performance and efficiency of existing MLLMs. Project page: https://clare-nie.github.io/Light-Omni.

e4ffb7ee50.method: Recent unified multimodal models show a single architecture can jointly perform vision/language understanding and image generation/editing. However, they repeatedly feed all historical visual and textual inputs into a shared context window, limiting long-horizon multimodal dialogue due to visual token explosion and unreliable cross-turn referencing. We propose a Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent that externalizes visual information into an Episodic Visual Memory and selectively reactivates relevant episodes during reasoning. The agent consists of a Perceptual Abstraction Engine for structured visual abstraction, a Cognitive Retrieval Engine for cross-turn memory retrieval, and a Multimodal Executive Controller for autonomous task inference and action planning. To address the lack of turn-level retrieval supervision in existing datasets, we develop a Unified Scenario Engine that programmatically generates structured multi-turn conversations with fine-grained retrieval annotations, enabling reinforcement learning to optimize abstraction and retrieval policies. We also construct a long-horizon visual-dialogue benchmark stratified by difficulty to evaluate episodic visual recall. Our 8B agent achieves 91.4% retrieval accuracy over 20-turn sessions, surpassing 32B baselines by +8.2% while nearly halving per-turn inference time (23.1s -> 12.7s). We further present the Cognitive-structured Multimodal Agent Harness (CMA-Harness), a tool-augmented deployment of the same cognitive structure integrating persistent multimodal memory, web access, image generation/editing/composition tools, and OpenAI-compatible serving. 21a60eab7a.tl_dr: We present Wan-Streamer v0.3, which reframes our native-streaming interaction model under a single organizing view: a video is a world plus an event stream. The world is the persistent context in which a video unfolds, including the environ
21a60eab7a.problem: 仅处理语音的助手无法覆盖面对面交互中的动作、表情或连续视觉线索，跨模态时序也难以保持同步。
21a60eab7a.method: We present Wan-Streamer v0.3, which reframes our native-streaming interaction model under a single organizing view: a video is a world plus an event stream. The world is the persistent context in which a video unfolds, including the environment, scene, subjects, ambient acoustic conditions, voice characteristics, and other relatively stable conditions. The event stream is everything that changes over time within that world, including scene or environmental changes, subject behavior, speech, and other sounds. This yields a general-purpose pretraining task over large amounts of real video: given a world and incoming input, predict how the world moves, changes, and responds in real time. The resulting competence can be specialized to a broad family of real-time downstream tasks. We instantiate it on real-time full-duplex audio-visual interaction, where the event stream is the agent's speech together with free-form behavior. Functionally, the model's multimodal understanding process is vision-language-action-like: it maps multimodal user input to language-form speech and behavior actions. Wan-Streamer v0.3 preserves the v0.2 operating point: 640x368 video at 25 FPS, a 160 ms streaming unit, approximately 200 ms model-side response latency, and approximately 550 ms total interaction latency under a 350 ms bidirectional network budget.

ebc6945228.tl_dr: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal canno
ebc6945228.problem: 全双工模型在追求低延迟交互时容易牺牲推理、指令遵循或长期状态一致性。
ebc6945228.method: Multimodal agents for visual question answering increasingly operate as multi-step trajectories that interleave perception, retrieval, and reasoning, yet evaluation still largely reduces to final-answer accuracy. This aggregate signal cannot tell whether a correct answer was reached through grounded evidence, language priors, or accidental error cancellation. We propose to treat a multimodal agent trajectory as a provenance-constrained state machine: tool outputs are normalized into a Structured Evidence Ledger that serves as the trajectory state, downstream reasoning and decision claims may cite only active ledger entries, grounding is checked at the entity and numeric level, and repair is realized as typed state transitions that cannot introduce content without tool-produced provenance. We instantiate this design as LedgerMind (Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger), augmented by a Three-Layer Grounding Protocol, an Adaptive Dual-Path Dispatcher that matches reasoning depth to question complexity, and an Event-Triggered Verification-and-Repair engine with a formal provenance non-amplification guarantee. We use LedgerMind to target four recurring failure patterns that final-answer accuracy tends to obscure: unsupported intermediate reasoning, citation-backed entity hallucination (Phantom Grounding), over-reasoning on simple queries, and repair-time amplification. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks and backbone MLLMs show that LedgerMind improves both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness.

3e5ebfc066.method: We are entering a new era of composite model architectures that integrate diverse components such as vision encoders, language backbones, diffusion and flow heads, audio codecs, action generators, and world-model predictors. Such architectures underpin a broad class of multimodal models, including unified multimodal models, omni models, speech-language models, vision-language-action policies, and world models. However, existing model serving frameworks were built on narrow assumptions about model structure, making them ill-suited to accommodate this new architectural diversity. Here we present M*, a universal serving system for efficient serving of composite AI models. M* represents models as dataflow graphs, processing requests spanning diverse modalities and tasks as traversals over these graphs. The core insight is a modular abstraction that supports arbitrary composition of model components, flexible placement onto a physical cluster, and model-agnostic optimizations within a distributed runtime. We call this abstraction the Walk Graph and show how it can concisely capture composite models from a broad range of families. We instantiate M* on representative models and find that it achieves, on average, 20% lower end-to-end latency than vLLM-Omni for text-to-image workloads on BAGEL, while delivering up to 2.9x lower real-time factor and 2.7x higher throughput for text-to-speech workloads on Qwen3-Omni. M* also outperforms the V-JEPA 2-AC rollout baseline for robotic planning by up to 12.5x. Thus, our work paves the road towards more efficient serving of complex models with minimal developer effort.

ab4dbde172.method: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have strong potential as embodied agents, but their ability to collaborate in visually grounded environments remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce MECoBench, a multimodal embodied cooperation benchmark with an evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world tasks, two cooperation structures, and three collaboration modes. Through extensive experiments across various MLLMs, we summarize three key findings: (i) Collaboration generally improves embodied task completion, but its benefits depend on balancing collaborative gains against coordination complexity. (ii) Communication is essential to collaboration gains, while the best collaboration mode depends on team size and model capability. (iii) Moreover, collaboration improves robustness under noisy priors and exploration conditions. Generally, MECoBench provides a systematic testbed for understanding the mechanisms and limits of multimodal embodied collaboration. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/q-i-n-g/MECoBench.

5af78d53e4.method: End-to-end speech-in speech-out dialogue systems are emerging as a powerful alternative to traditional ASR-LLM-TTS pipelines, generating more natural, expressive responses with significantly lower latency. However, these systems remain prone to hallucinations due to limited factual grounding. While text-based dialogue systems address this challenge by integrating tools such as web search and knowledge graph APIs, we introduce the first approach to extend tool use directly into speech-in speech-out systems. A key challenge is that tool integration substantially increases response latency, disrupting conversational flow. To mitigate this, we propose Streaming Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Streaming RAG), a novel framework that reduces user-perceived latency by predicting tool queries in parallel with user speech, even before the user finishes speaking. Specifically, we develop a post-training pipeline that teaches the model when to issue tool calls during ongoing speech and how to generate spoken summaries that fuse audio queries with retrieved text results, thereby improving both accuracy and responsiveness. To evaluate our approach, we construct AudioCRAG, a benchmark created by converting queries from the publicly available CRAG dataset into speech form. Experimental results demonstrate that our streaming RAG approach increases QA accuracy by up to 200% relative (from 11.1% to 34.2% absolute) and further enhances user experience by reducing tool use latency by 20%. Importantly, our streaming RAG approach is modality-agnostic and can be applied equally to typed input, paving the way for more agentic, real-time AI assistants.

219d8f814d.tl_dr: Achieving human-like responsiveness is a critical yet challenging goal for cascaded spoken dialogue systems. Conventional ASR-LLM-TTS pipelines follow a strictly sequential paradigm, requiring complete transcription and full reasoning befor

219d8f814d.method: Achieving human-like responsiveness is a critical yet challenging goal for cascaded spoken dialogue systems. Conventional ASR-LLM-TTS pipelines follow a strictly sequential paradigm, requiring complete transcription and full reasoning before speech synthesis can begin, which results in high response latency. We propose the Discourse-Aware Dual-Track Streaming Response (DDTSR) framework, a low-latency architecture that enables listen-while-thinking and speak-while-thinking. DDTSR is built upon three key mechanisms: (1) connective-guided small-large model synergy, where an auxiliary small model generates minimal-committal discourse connectives while a large model performs knowledge-intensive reasoning in parallel; (2) streaming-based cross-modal collaboration, which dynamically overlaps ASR, LLM inference, and TTS to advance the earliest speakable moment; and (3) curriculum-learning-based discourse continuity enhancement, which maintains coherence and logical consistency between early responses and subsequent reasoning outputs. Experiments on two spoken dialogue benchmarks demonstrate that DDTSR reduces response latency by 19%-51% while preserving discourse quality. Further analysis shows that DDTSR functions as a plug-and-play module compatible with diverse LLM backbones, and remains robust across varying utterance lengths, indicating strong practicality and scalability for real-time spoken interaction.

854193be76.method: Every day, millions absorb claims from podcasts and streams that no fact-checker ever sees. Spoken misinformation is built through conversation, where credibility comes not from facts alone but from how claims are framed, reinforced, or left unchallenged across turns. Yet fact-checking has focused on isolated text, leaving dialogue audio under-studied. We introduce MAD2, a new Multi-turn Audio Dialogues benchmark for spoken claim verification, containing 1,000 two-speaker dialogues with 3,368 check-worthy claims and approximately 10 hours of audio, and propose calibrated multimodal fusion of a context-aware audio encoder and a dialogue-aware text model. Across settings, adding dialogue context improves verification, but the gains depend on scenario type. Using only preceding context often matches offline performance, supporting live-moderation settings, and audio contributes most when transcript-based models are destabilized by additional context. Overall, conversational structure matters more for verification than misinformation framing.

c59bca301f.method: Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved remarkable progress in short-form audio-video understanding, yet long-form audio-video comprehension remains challenged by limited context windows and severe information redundancy. To address these bottlenecks, we propose AVOC, a framework for long-form audio-video understanding in Omni-modal Large Language Models. AVOC introduces a learnable token compression module between the modality encoders and the LLM backbone. We reframe multimodal token compression as a top-$K$ retrieval problem: given a fixed context budget, the module must retrieve a compact subset of tokens that best supports answering the user query. We draw inspiration from three classical Information Retrieval criteria for selecting informative units from a large candidate pool: relevance, importance, and diversity. AVOC instantiates each criterion as a tailored mechanism for audio-video understanding, and integrates them into a unified retrieval-style compression pipeline. Experiments show that AVOC achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-form audio-video benchmarks, surpassing the second-best model by 4.9 and 5.5 points in average accuracy on OmniVideoBench and LVOmniBench, respectively. Moreover, AVOC maintains robust performance on Audio-Video Needle-in-a-Haystack task at durations up to one hour.

5c3479442c.method: Research on agent memory has matured rapidly, but almost entirely on the text side: few existing benchmarks ask, in an interactive environment, when an agent genuinely needs to remember what it saw rather than what it could write down. We introduce DMV-Bench (Code: https://github.com/yyyujintang/DMV-Bench), the first interactive benchmark for multimodal-agent visual memory. DMV-Bench is built on a controlled home-furnishing e-commerce catalogue of 1,000 product variants in which a text-leakage contract keeps the discriminative signal of each task in the pixels alone. Across a chain of autonomous shopping sessions, every visited product image carries a unique, pre-rendered incidental cue, and the agent is later asked to recall a particular cued product and navigate to its URL. Inspired by dual-coding theory, we propose DualMem, a memory architecture that maintains a visual and a verbal code in parallel. On DMV-Bench, DualMem outperforms a caption baseline and three recent multimodal agent-memory systems at every chain length J in {5, 10, 15, 50} on both Gemini 2.5 Flash and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, with the lead surviving controls for memory-bank size and encoding-position bias, and an asymmetric dual-coding regime in which vision carries the cue end-to-end while the verbal channel plays a smaller query-grounding role.

0f6fd313bd.method: Multi-round reflection lets agents built on large language models recover from failures within a single task, but each task remains an isolated episode: lessons learned across many reflection rounds on one task are discarded before the next begins. We study this gap on a code-generation task: from a scientific paper section, the agent writes Python in the open-source Manim library to render a mathematical animation. We present ManimAgent, a self-evolving multimodal agent that carries reflection experience across tasks through a dual-channel Episodic Memory Bank grown entirely from its own task stream, with no weight updates and no human seeds. After each animation converges, a vision-language model scores the rendered keyframes; the resulting signals populate a positive channel M+ that stores success rationales as soft Reference Examples, and a negative channel M- that stores validated failure patterns as hard Known Pitfalls. On a fixed-probe evaluation against no-memory, matched-budget retrieval-augmented generation, and shuffled-memory baselines, blind human Pass@1 rises and reflection rounds fall as memory size grows. We will release the code, frozen memory snapshots, and the task stream.

0cc89f3e2e.method: We present SimpleSearch-VL, an efficient, reliable, and practical framework for multimodal agentic search. Its core idea is to improve the agent's own search-and-verification process rather than scaling data, tools, or auxiliary model components. For efficiency, Factorized Adaptive Rollout (FAR) improves sampling efficiency by forming more informative training groups while using redundant samples to mitigate long-tail latency and expose hard samples. For reliability, SimpleSearch-VL performs evidence-verified reasoning, explicitly using chain-of-thought verification to assess the relevance of retrieved visual and textual cues to the original context. For practicality, SimpleSearch-VL keeps a lightweight tool interface and performs webpage self-summary within the agent, requiring no additional external dependencies. With only 5K supervised tool-interleaved trajectories and 2K RL data, SimpleSearch-VL improves Qwen3-VL agentic baselines by 15.8 and 16.0 average points for the 8B and 30B-A3B variants, respectively. The SimpleSearch-VL-30B-A3B model further achieves performance competitive with agentic Gemini-3-Pro.

41560b57ab.method: Autonomous aerial inspection of marine infrastructure is frequently compromised by stochastic sea states, introducing risks of high-kinetic impacts, post-landing toppling, and sensory occlusion. This paper proposes a decoupled, multi-vehicle landing framework synchronizing an Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) equipped with a 3-RPU stabilized platform with a robust Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). The architecture utilizes two independent Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agents: a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent providing high-frequency wave-motion compensation for the landing deck, and a multimodal RL agent for the UAVs final approach. Results show a mean stabilization efficacy of 87.8%, maintaining the landing surface within 1 degree of the horizontal plane for 96% of the mission duration in rough conditions, effectively contributing to safer landings.

dcd7184d58.method: Omni-modal evidence-seeking QA requires agents to answer questions whose evidence is sparsely distributed across videos, audio, images, web pages, and computation results. Existing agentic multimodal systems often leave evidence in scratchpads, tool trajectories, or free-form histories, making it difficult to track what has been grounded, what remains missing, and when the evidence is sufficient to answer. We propose Omni-Decision, a training-free evidence-state system that turns omni-modal QA into a query-scoped evidence-closure process. For each query, Omni-Decision maintains a structured evidence state containing confirmed evidence, unresolved conflicts, fact and computation dependencies, and open evidence needs. A shared state view conditions planning, evidence acquisition, validation, repair, and finalization. Heterogeneous observations from media, web, computation, and verification modules are normalized, judged, and committed through deterministic state updates. This design enables targeted evidence acquisition, preserves sparse cross-modal cues, and provides inspectable control over repair and stopping. Omni-Decision achieves 45.6% accuracy on OmniGAIA and 58.3% on WorldSense, improving over the baselines by +27.3 and +30.2 percentage points, respectively. No-state ablations and trajectory audits further support the role of explicit evidence-state control in multi-step omni-modal evidence seeking.

52daaa0251.method: We present VetClaw, an edge-cloud multimodal agentic system for early veterinary disease screening. VetClaw uses a camera module as an edge sensing device and sends captured images, together with optional symptom descriptions, to a server-hosted vision-language model for zero-shot disease classification. The system separates agent interaction from workflow orchestration: OpenClaw provides scheduling, tool access, user interaction, and notification services on the edge device, while LangGraph manages the stateful screening workflow, including input validation, image transmission, model invocation, safety checks, conditional routing, failure handling, and structured logging. This design moves beyond static image classification by enabling the system to collect visual evidence, invoke external models, apply deterministic safety rules, and generate diagnostic-support alerts. Results show that image-only VLM prediction remains limited, whereas symptom-guided and multimodal inputs improve zero-shot classification performance. Thus, VetClaw transforms a static prediction model into a coordinated, safety-aware system that can use tools, manage workflows, handle failures, and escalate uncertain cases.

cf9f84810a.method: Social deduction games (SDGs) such as Werewolf have become challenging testbeds for AI agents. These games require complex social skills such as reasoning, deception, and collaboration. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have driven significant progress in SDG agents, current approaches are predominantly text-based, overlooking the multimodal nature that is fundamental to human social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce CaM-Wolf, the first SDG agent that integrates multimodal perception and generation. CaM-Wolf processes video inputs from other players, employs a causal-aware Reasoner trained via reinforcement learning to establish logical chains between observable behaviors and hidden roles, and presents itself through an animated avatar. Our experiments and user study show that CaM-Wolf achieves superior agent gameplay performance and enhances the quality of human-AI interaction. This work represents a significant advancement towards creating more human-like AI agents capable of participating in nuanced social dynamics. Our code is available at https://3dagentworld.github.io/avatar_wolf.

410933a97d.method: Wearable sensors, such as smartwatches, have become increasingly prevalent across domains like healthcare, sports, and education, enabling continuous monitoring of physiological and behavioral data. In the context of education, these technologies offer new opportunities to study cognitive and affective processes such as engagement, attention, and performance. However, the lack of scalable, synchronized, and high-resolution tools for multimodal data acquisition continues to be a significant barrier to the widespread adoption of Multimodal Learning Analytics in real-world educational settings. This paper presents two complementary tools developed to address these challenges: Watch-DMLT, a data acquisition application for Fitbit Sense 2 smartwatches that enables real-time, multi-user monitoring of physiological and motion signals; and ViSeDOPS, a dashboard-based visualization system for analyzing synchronized multimodal data collected during oral presentations. We report on a classroom deployment involving 65 students and up to 16 smartwatches, where data streams including heart rate, motion, gaze, video, and contextual annotations were captured and analyzed. Results demonstrate the feasibility and utility of the proposed system for supporting fine-grained, scalable, and interpretable Multimodal Learning Analytics in real learning environments.

2cd0983fbd.method: Full-stack multimodal interaction in real-time is a central goal in building intelligent embodied agents capable of natural, dynamic communication. However, existing systems are either limited to unimodal generation or suffer from degraded reasoning and poor cross-modal alignment, preventing coherent and perceptually grounded interactions. In this work, we introduce U-Mind, the first unified system for high-intelligence multimodal dialogue that supports real-time generation and jointly models language, speech, motion, and video synthesis within a single interactive loop. At its core, U-Mind implements a Unified Alignment and Reasoning Framework that addresses two key challenges: enhancing cross-modal synchronization via a segment-wise alignment strategy, and preserving reasoning abilities through Rehearsal-Driven Learning. During inference, U-Mind adopts a text-first decoding pipeline that performs internal chain-of-thought planning followed by temporally synchronized generation across modalities. To close the loop, we implement a real-time video rendering framework conditioned on pose and speech, enabling expressive and synchronized visual feedback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that U-Mind achieves state-of-the-art performance on a range of multimodal interaction tasks, including question answering, instruction following, and motion generation, paving the way toward intelligent, immersive conversational agents.

ca6c85d290.method: Audio has rapidly become a primary interface for foundation models, powering real-time voice assistants. Ensuring safety in audio systems is inherently more complex than just "unsafe text spoken aloud": real-world risks can hinge on audio-native harmful sound events, speaker attributes (e.g., child voice), impersonation/voice-cloning misuse, and voice-content compositional harms, such as child voice plus sexual content. The nature of audio makes it challenging to develop comprehensive benchmarks or guardrails against this unique risk landscape. To close this gap, we conduct large-scale red teaming on audio systems, systematically uncover vulnerabilities in audio, and develop a comprehensive, policy-grounded audio risk taxonomy and AudioSafetyBench, the first policy-based audio safety benchmark across diverse threat models. AudioSafetyBench supports diverse languages, suspicious voices (e.g., celebrity/impersonation and child voice), risky voice-content combinations, and non-speech sound events. To defend against these threats, we propose AudioGuard, a unified guardrail consisting of 1) SoundGuard for waveform-level audio-native detection and 2) ContentGuard for policy-grounded semantic protection. Extensive experiments on AudioSafetyBench and four complementary benchmarks show that AudioGuard consistently improves guardrail accuracy over strong audio-LLM-based baselines with substantially lower latency.

8baa8530b2.method: Voice assistants increasingly rely on Speech Language Models (SpeechLMs) to interpret spoken queries and execute complex tasks, yet existing benchmarks lack domain breadth, acoustic diversity, and compositional reasoning complexity to evaluate tool-calling performance. We introduce Audio2Tool, a large-scale dataset comprising approximately 30,000 queries designed to assess tool-calling capabilities of SpeechLMs across three primary domains: Smart Car, Smart Home, and Wearables. Our benchmark features a multi-tier complexity hierarchy, ranging from simple direct commands to complex multi-intent and needle-in-a-haystack extraction to isolate distinct failure modes. To ensure realism, we employ zero-shot voice cloning text-to-speech synthesis and diverse noise profiles to simulate in-the-wild conditions. Evaluations of state-of-the-art SpeechLMs and ASR-LLM pipelines show strong performance on simple commands but significant degradation under compositional and acoustic challenges. Code and dataset are publicly available on the project page: https://audio2tool.github.io/.

02e7b8bcb7.method: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery improves surgical precision but introduces complexity, making technical error detection essential for ensuring patient safety. Current executional error detection methods using video data often overlook fine-grained contextual descriptions of activities and error types within the hierarchical structure of surgical procedures. They also under-utilize complementary multimodal information. We propose a unified framework for executional error detection that leverages multimodal input, including video, kinematics, and descriptive textual prompts. Through activity prompting, we integrate descriptive language in gesture-level activities, instrument-object interactions, and error definitions. We also introduce activity-aware visual embeddings derived from vision encoders pretrained on surgical activity labels to compare the effectiveness of contrastive language-image embeddings with traditional image-based embeddings for error detection. By seamlessly integrating kinematic data with video and textual modalities, our framework significantly improves error detection performance. Achieving up to 5\% and 16.6\% F1 score improvements over state-of-the-art baselines on the JIGSAWS and SAR-RARP50 datasets, respectively, we demonstrate the value of combining curated textual prompts with multimodal data for accurate error detection.

fe021672c7.method: We find that current emotion-oriented Omni-MLLMs still lack reliable omni-modal perception: they (i) underutilize multimodal cues in their reasoning trajectories and (ii) exhibit unfaithful behavior, often hallucinating modality-specific statements from other modalities. Building on these insights, we propose OPPO (Omni-Perception Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly optimizes multimodal perception. First, an Omni-Perception Reward decomposes ground-truth reasoning into fine-grained visual, acoustic, and emotion cues and rewards trajectories that semantically recover these cues. Second, an Omni-Perception Loss compares the policy under full and unimodally masked inputs, applying a KL penalty only to modality-specific evidence tokens to suppress cross-modal hallucination. We further introduce MEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that quantifies utilization and faithfulness. Experiments show that OPPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on MER-UniBench and MME-Emotion, while substantially improving utilization and faithfulness scores on MEP-Bench, highlighting the importance of sufficient and faithful omni perception for multimodal emotion reasoning.

857d83c211.tl_dr: Multimodal agents that think with images iteratively manipulate visual evidence and invoke tools across many steps. Existing reinforcement learning methods reduce trajectories to scalar rewards, forcing the policy to discover reusable tool-
857d83c211.problem: 论文针对全双工语音或流式多模态交互中的一项具体能力缺口提出新方法。
857d83c211.method: Multimodal agents that think with images iteratively manipulate visual evidence and invoke tools across many steps. Existing reinforcement learning methods reduce trajectories to scalar rewards, forcing the policy to discover reusable tool-use patterns from scratch on every new task; memory-based alternatives retain past experience, yet they rely on test-time retrieval, without updating the policy to absorb reusable patterns from that experience. Our key insight is that multimodal reasoning trajectories should be distilled into reusable skills that co-evolve with the policy during training, rather than being consumed as rewards or retrieved from a static store. To this end, we propose SPyCE (Skill-Policy Co-evolution), a framework that distills trajectories into a hierarchical skill library and updates it throughout reinforcement learning. Execution skills capture local visual operations, while workflow skills encode high-level priors that orchestrate tool use. During training, the policy model conditions on retrieved skills to guide its rollouts, while the skill library evolves using valuable rollouts generated by the policy. This creates a closed loop in which improved policies yield better skills, and the evolving skill library, in turn, provides stronger priors for policy rollouts. Experiments across eight benchmarks demonstrate that SPyCE consistently outperforms both RL-based and memory-based baselines. Further analysis reveals that both the hierarchical skill design and the co-evolution mechanism are critical to our design. These results suggest joint skill-policy optimization as a promising paradigm for building capable multimodal agents.

80e73f7a2c.tl_dr: We present S1-Omni, a unified multimodal reasoning model for scientific understanding, prediction, and generation. AI for Science (AI4S) has advanced significantly through domain-specific models, tool-augmented LLMs, and scientific language

80e73f7a2c.method: We present S1-Omni, a unified multimodal reasoning model for scientific understanding, prediction, and generation. AI for Science (AI4S) has advanced significantly through domain-specific models, tool-augmented LLMs, and scientific language models. However, model capabilities remain highly fragmented, limiting the joint modeling of heterogeneous data, scientific laws, and expert knowledge. S1-Omni addresses this gap by consolidating these capabilities into a single, coherent scientific reasoning model. The architecture of S1-Omni is built upon three core components: unified representation of scientific data, natural-world knowledge alignment, and decoding for domain-specific tasks. First, S1-Omni maps natural-language instructions and scientific objects, including CIF, SMILES, protein sequences, spectra, and scientific images, into a shared representation space. Second, it incorporates scientific laws and expert knowledge into data construction and training, enabling the model to reason from scientific evidence. Third, it performs task-specific decoding to support a broad range of applications, including property prediction, spectrum-to-molecular generation, protein site and structure prediction, and scientific image generation and editing. S1-Omni is trained on S1-Omni-Corpus, which covers 200 scientific tasks and contains millions of reasoning samples, and is evaluated on over 60 scientific benchmarks. It outperforms GPT-5.5 and Gemini-3.1-Pro on most benchmarks and matches or surpasses domain-specific models on several benchmarks. Overall, S1-Omni provides a practical path toward unified scientific modeling.

Without any retraining, an English-trained adapter also produces fluent Spanish speech, indicating that the face-to-style mapping is largely language-agnostic.

a5f2fbbd48.tl_dr: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal large language models typically rely on one modality to determine what to retain in the other. We show that this assumption often breaks down: for the same query, audio and video relevance of
a5f2fbbd48.problem: 论文针对全双工语音或流式多模态交互中的一项具体能力缺口提出新方法。
a5f2fbbd48.method: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal large language models typically rely on one modality to determine what to retain in the other. We show that this assumption often breaks down: for the same query, audio and video relevance often peaks at different moments. This cross-modal salience mismatch makes unidirectional guidance prone to discarding answer-critical cues under aggressive compression. We propose OmniScope, a training-free token compression framework that uses the query as a shared semantic anchor while estimating relevance separately for audio and video. OmniScope allocates modality-specific token budgets, prunes visual tokens with an anchor-delta strategy that preserves both global context and temporal changes, and merges audio tokens within each second to reduce redundancy while maintaining temporal continuity. Across four audio-video benchmarks and two Qwen2.5-Omni model scales, OmniScope achieves the best average accuracy across all compression settings. At 25% overall token retention, it delivers up to 3.53x prefill speedup and more than 15% GPU memory reduction, with only a 0.35-point drop in average accuracy. These results suggest a simple design principle for OmniLLM inference: share the query across modalities, but not the salience estimates. The code is available at https://github.com/MAC-AutoML/OmniScope.
